| **Fields — Organs at risk (repeating, per phase or per course)**              | OAR name (coded from OAR Master `[CCA CONFIG]`, R); Laterality; **Constraint** (repeating per OAR): constraint type (dropdown — product-defined: Maximum dose / Mean dose / Dose to a volume (Dx%) / Volume receiving a dose (Vx Gy) / Dose to a volume in cc (Dxcc) / Other), metric parameter (numeric, e.g. the x in V20), operator (≤ / < / ≥ / >), constraint value (numeric), unit (Gy, %, cc), constraint class (dropdown: Hard — must not be exceeded / Optimal — aim / Acceptable variation), source of constraint `[CCA CONFIG — CLINICAL SIGN-OFF]` (protocol name and version), notes. Prior-dose adjustment applied (Y/N + value + basis, for re-irradiation).                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                       |
| **Fields — Immobilisation and positioning**                                   | Patient position (dropdown: Supine / Prone / Lateral / Sitting / Other); Arm position; Head position; Immobilisation devices (multiselect `[CCA CONFIG]`: thermoplastic mask — points of fixation, headrest type and index, vac-bag, breast board with angle, belly board, knee/ankle fix, wing board, bite block, other) with device ID and index positions; Bolus required (Y/N; material, thickness in mm, location, frequency — every fraction / alternate / specified); Skin marks/tattoos (description); Motion management (dropdown: None / Free breathing / Breath-hold — inspiration / Breath-hold — expiration / Gating / Abdominal compression / Tracking) with parameters; Bladder/bowel/stomach preparation protocol `[CCA CONFIG]`; Special positioning notes.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      |
| **Fields — Image guidance**                                                   | IGRT modality (dropdown: None / kV planar / MV planar / kV CBCT / MV CT / Surface guidance / Ultrasound / Implanted markers / MR); Frequency (dropdown: Daily / First n fractions then weekly / Weekly / Alternate / Per protocol — with the pattern); Matching structures (multiselect: bony anatomy — named, soft tissue — named, markers, surface); **Action levels/tolerances** (numeric per translational axis in mm and rotational axis in degrees, with the action required when exceeded — dropdown: correct and proceed / re-image / call RO / call physics — `[CCA CONFIG — CLINICAL SIGN-OFF]`); Imaging dose consideration; Who may approve an out-of-tolerance match (role).                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                         |
| **Fields — Concurrent therapy**                                               | Concurrent systemic therapy (Y/N; regimen link; timing relative to fractions; coordinating MO); Other concurrent modality; Sequencing constraints.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                |
| **Fields — Special instructions**                                             | Instructions to simulation; to planning/dosimetry; to physics; to RTT; to nursing (skin care, supportive medication); contraindications and cautions; supportive medications prescribed for the course.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                           |
| **Fields — Course totals**                                                    | Total course dose `[DERIVED]` (sum across phases where volumes overlap — **the screen must state whether phases are additive to the same volume or to different volumes**, `RO-050 [PRODUCT]`); Total fractions `[DERIVED]`; Overall treatment time in days `[DERIVED]`; EQD2/BED where CCA configures the capability `[CCA CONFIG — CLINICAL SIGN-OFF for α/β values]` (`CALC-176`, inputs, formula and α/β displayed).                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          |
| **Tables**                                                                    | Phases; target volumes per phase; OAR constraint table (OAR, constraint type, parameter, operator, value, unit, class, source, prior-dose adjustment); immobilisation devices; version history.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                   |
| **Dropdowns**                                                                 | Modality, technique, volume type, constraint type, position, motion management, IGRT modality (product-defined backbones); site, OAR names, immobilisation devices, constraint sources, protocol templates (`[CCA CONFIG]`).                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      |
| **Calculated**                                                                | Dose per fraction or total dose (whichever is derived); planned end date; total course dose; total fractions; overall treatment time; EQD2/BED where configured; consistency checks (see alerts).                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                 |
| **Actions**                                                                   | Apply prescription template `[CCA CONFIG]` (versioned; stamps the template version on the prescription) · Add phase · Add target volume · Add OAR constraint · Import OAR constraint set from protocol · Copy from previous phase · Validate · Save draft · **Sign** · Create new version · Print.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                |
| **Chips**                                                                     | Prescription status (Draft / Signed / Superseded / Cancelled / Completed); version number; template version; phases n; re-irradiation flag; CIED flag.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            |
| **Alerts**                                                                    | **Hard stop on sign:** total dose, fractions or dose/fraction missing or internally inconsistent; no target volume defined for a phase; no technique or modality; no immobilisation specified; no IGRT specification; CIED present without management plan; prior RT status unknown; consent required and absent per `[CCA CONFIG]`; dose per fraction or total dose outside the configured plausibility envelope for the technique `[CCA CONFIG — CLINICAL SIGN-OFF]` (e.g. a conventional fractionation value entered against an SBRT technique) — **RO-060 [PRODUCT]**: the product must hold technique-specific dose plausibility envelopes and hard-stop outside them, since dose/fractionation transcription errors are among the most consequential errors in radiotherapy. **Override with reason:** constraint exceeding the protocol's hard class; re-irradiation without complete prior-dose data; unconventional fractionation within the envelope but outside the template. **Warning:** newer prescription template version available; planned end date conflicts with a scheduled systemic cycle; overall treatment time exceeding the protocol's recommended maximum `[CCA CONFIG]`.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              |
| **Conditional logic**                                                         | Brachytherapy modality replaces the energy/technique fields with applicator, source, dwell and fractionation fields `[CCA CONFIG]`. Motion-management parameters appear per selection. Re-irradiation fields appear when prior RT overlap ≠ none. Multi-phase totals appear when phases > 1.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      |
| **Read-only**                                                                 | Clinical basis imports; derived values; template content.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                         |
| **Sign/approve**                                                              | RO signature with re-authentication. On signature every clinical import is frozen by value. **RO-070 [PRODUCT]** — where `[CCA CONFIG]` requires it (e.g. SBRT/SRS, re-irradiation, paediatric), a second RO peer review signature is required before the prescription is released to planning; the product must support configurable peer-review requirements by technique and by site.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          |
| **Amendment/version**                                                         | Any change to a signed prescription creates **Version n+1** with a mandatory reason (dropdown: dose change on clinical grounds / fractionation change / target volume change / constraint change / technique change / error correction / patient factor / toxicity / progression). The prior version is retained, marked `SUPERSEDED`, and remains linked to any plan, QA record and fraction delivered under it. **RO-080 [PRODUCT]** — creating a new prescription version automatically sets any plan built on the prior version to `PLAN REQUIRES RE-APPROVAL` and any QA to `QA INVALIDATED`, and notifies planning, physics and the treating unit. Fractions already delivered under the prior version remain attributed to it, and the completion summary must show delivery split by prescription version.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                |
| **Current vs previous**                                                       | Version comparison: field-by-field diff with changed cells highlighted, plus a summary of the clinical impact (dose changed from x to y, n fractions already delivered under the prior version).                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  |
| **Post-signature**                                                            | Prescription immutable; simulation may be requested; planning may begin; the prescription becomes the reference object for concordance checking (`SCR-PHY-002`).                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  |
| **Downstream queues**                                                         | Simulation request queue; dosimetry/planning queue; physics QA queue (later); RTT unit schedule (after release); scheduling for fraction booking; Navigator; MO where concurrent therapy applies.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                 |
| **Blocked/error**                                                             | Cannot sign without an OAR Master and a constraint source; cannot sign for a site with no configured technique options — configuration gaps surface as explicit errors naming the missing master.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                 |
| **Print/export**                                                              | RT Prescription (full, version-stamped); prescription summary for the treatment unit; patient course information sheet (`PTP-150`).                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                               |

## C.15.4 · `SCR-RO-004` — Simulation Request & CT-Simulation Record

| Dimension Specification                             |                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  |
| --------------------------------------------------- | -------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| **Role(s)**                                         | RO (request, attend, approve); RTT/simulation radiographer (perform and record); nursing (support).                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              |
| **Navigation**                                      | Prescription → Request simulation; pathway board; simulation unit schedule.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      |
| **Purpose**                                         | Acquire the planning dataset in the treatment position, with reproducible immobilisation and documented reference marks.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                         |
| **Header**                                          | Full RO header + prescription strip (read-only): site, laterality, technique, position, immobilisation, motion management.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                       |
| **Sections**                                        | 1 Request · 2 Preparation & safety · 3 Positioning & immobilisation performed · 4 Acquisition · 5 Reference marks · 6 Contrast · 7 Fiducials/applicators · 8 Issues & deviations · 9 Approval.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                   |
| **Fields — Request**                                | Requested by; requested date; urgency; target simulation date; scan protocol required (dropdown `[CCA CONFIG]`: slice thickness, extent superior/inferior limits, contrast requirement, 4D/breath-hold, respiratory correlation); Additional imaging for fusion required (MR, PET — with modality, protocol, whether same-position acquisition needed); special requirements (sedation, anaesthesia, interpreter, mobility, isolation); pre-simulation preparation `[CCA CONFIG]` (bladder filling, bowel preparation, fasting, oral contrast timing).                           |
| **Fields — Preparation & safety**                   | Identity verified (two identifiers, method); Pregnancy check performed where applicable (result, date/time); Prior RT confirmed; CIED confirmed and plan noted; Allergy check for contrast; Renal function for contrast (value, date, `[DERIVED]` eGFR); Consent status; Preparation instructions followed (Y/N + detail); Patient able to maintain position for the required duration (Y/N + notes).                                                                                                                                                                            |
| **Fields — Positioning & immobilisation performed** | Position (as prescribed — confirm or record deviation with reason); Arm/head position; Immobilisation devices used with **device ID and index/serial positions** (repeating: device type, ID, index values per axis, notes) — **RO-090 [PRODUCT]**: device index values are structured numeric fields, because they are what makes the setup reproducible; Headrest type and index; Vac-bag ID; Mask ID and fixation points; Knee/ankle fix index; Wing board index; Bolus applied at simulation (Y/N, spec); Positioning aids; Comfort measures; Position tolerance assessment. |
| **Fields — Acquisition**                            | Scanner/unit; Protocol used; Scan date/time; Slice thickness (mm); Scan extent (superior and inferior anatomical limits); Field of view; 4D acquisition (Y/N, phases, respiratory trace quality); Breath-hold (type, achieved duration, reproducibility); Number of scans acquired; Additional datasets acquired for fusion; Images transferred to TPS (Y/N, timestamp) `[INTEGRATION]`; Acquisition performed by; RO present (Y/N).                                                                                                                                             |
| **Fields — Reference marks**                        | Reference/setup point definition (anatomical description); Marks applied (dropdown: Tattoos — permanent / Semi-permanent marks / Surface guidance — no marks / Other) with count and locations; Coordinates of reference point relative to the scan origin (x, y, z in mm); Shift from reference to planned isocentre (to be completed at planning, or recorded here if isocentre set at simulation); Photographs of setup (with consent `[CCA CONFIG]`); Setup description narrative (free text, R).                                                                            |
| **Fields — Contrast**                               | Agent, volume, route, rate, timing, administered by, lot/expiry, adverse reaction (Y/N, link to reaction record).                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                |
| **Fields — Fiducials / applicators / spacers**      | Type, number, insertion date, inserting clinician, location, imaging confirmation.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                               |
| **Fields — Issues & deviations**                    | Deviation from prescribed position or immobilisation (Y/N + description + reason + RO notified); Patient tolerance issues; Repeat scan required (Y/N + reason); Additional dose from repeat imaging.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                             |
| **Fields — Approval**                               | Simulation acceptable for planning (Y/N — RO or delegated); Approved by; Approved at; Notes to planning.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                         |
| **Tables**                                          | Immobilisation device table (type, ID, index values, notes); datasets acquired (type, date, purpose, transferred); reference marks.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              |
| **Calculated**                                      | Time in position; scan extent length; interval from prescription to simulation `[DERIVED]`.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      |
| **Actions**                                         | Book simulation · Record preparation · Record setup · Record acquisition · Transfer to TPS · Record deviation · Approve for planning · Request re-simulation.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    |
| **Chips**                                           | Simulation status (Requested / Booked / In progress / Acquired / Transferred / Approved / Re-simulation required).                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                               |
| **Alerts**                                          | Hard stop on approval without a recorded position, immobilisation and reference point; warning if the position recorded differs from the prescription without a deviation record; warning if datasets have not transferred.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      |
| **Sign/approve**                                    | RTT records; RO approves for planning.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                           |
| **Amendment**                                       | Re-simulation creates a new simulation record; the prior remains, and plans must state which simulation dataset they used.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                       |
| **Downstream**                                      | Contouring queue (`SCR-RO-005`); planning; the immobilisation and setup record becomes the RTT's daily reference (`SCR-RTT-003`).                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                |
| **Print/export**                                    | CT Simulation Note (Part L); setup sheet for the treatment unit (position, devices, indices, marks, photographs).                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                |

screens.requirement_markdown:
## C.15.5 · `SCR-RO-005` — Contouring / Structure Set

| Dimension Specification                        |                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                             |
| ---------------------------------------------- | --------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| **Role(s)**                                    | RO (target volumes — **exclusively**); dosimetrist/RTT (OAR contours where delegated per `[CCA CONFIG]`); physicist (review).                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                               |
| **Navigation**                                 | Simulation approved → Contouring; pathway board.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            |
| **Purpose**                                    | Record the structure set as a governed, versioned, attributed clinical artifact. Geometry lives in the TPS `[INTEGRATION]`; the HIS records **what exists, who drew it, who approved it, and against which prescription**.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  |
| **Header**                                     | Prescription strip (read-only): phases, target volume names required, OAR list required.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    |
| **Sections**                                   | 1 Structure set identification · 2 Required structures checklist · 3 Structure register · 4 Delegation · 5 Peer review · 6 Approval.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        |
| **Table — structure register (exact columns)** | 1 Structure name (must match the prescription's declared volume names, `RO-040`) · 2 Structure type (GTV / CTV / ITV / PTV / OAR / PRV / Support / Bolus / Avoidance / Other) · 3 Phase applicability · 4 Laterality · 5 Volume (cc) `[INTEGRATION from TPS]` · 6 Drawn by · 7 Drawn on (date) · 8 Derived-from and margin (for expanded volumes) · 9 Imaging used (primary dataset + fused datasets with fusion method and quality assessment) · 10 Auto-segmented (Y/N + tool + version — **RO-100 [PRODUCT]**: auto-segmented structures must be flagged and must record whether they were reviewed and edited by a human, because an unreviewed auto-contour must never be treated as clinician-approved) · 11 Reviewed by · 12 Review outcome (Accepted / Edited / Rejected) · 13 Approved by · 14 Approved at · 15 Status (Draft / Complete / Approved / Superseded). |
| **Fields**                                     | Structure set version; source simulation dataset; fusion registrations used (repeating: secondary dataset, registration method, rigid/deformable, quality assessment, approved by); Required-structure completeness `[DERIVED]` against the prescription and the site template `[CCA CONFIG]`; Missing structures listed; Peer review performed (Y/N per `[CCA CONFIG]` rules by technique/site), reviewer, findings, changes made; RO approval statement; Notes to planning.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                               |
| **Calculated**                                 | Completeness against required set; structure count; total target volume; days from simulation to contour approval `[DERIVED]`.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              |
| **Actions**                                    | Import structure set from TPS · Refresh · Assign OAR contouring · Mark complete · Request peer review · Approve structure set · Return for revision (with comments).                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        |
| **Chips**                                      | Structure set status; completeness; auto-segmented present; peer review status.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                             |
| **Alerts**                                     | Hard stop on approval when a prescription-declared target volume has no corresponding structure; hard stop when an OAR carrying a hard constraint has no structure; warning when an auto-segmented structure has not been human-reviewed.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                   |
| **Sign/approve**                               | **Target volumes may only be approved by the RO** (`RO-110 [PRODUCT]`). OAR approval may be delegated per configuration but the delegation and the delegate are recorded.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                   |
| **Amendment/version**                          | Edits after approval create structure set version n+1; plans state which structure set version they used; changing the structure set invalidates plan approval in the same manner as a prescription change (`RO-080` analogue).                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                             |
| **Downstream**                                 | Planning queue with the approved structure set and prescription version.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    |
| **Print/export**                               | Contouring / Structure Set Record (Part L).                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                 |

## C.15.6 · `SCR-RO-006` — Treatment Planning Record

| Dimension Specification                                 |                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                         |
| ------------------------------------------------------- | ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| **Role(s)**                                             | Dosimetrist / planning RTT / physicist (create); RO (review and approve on `SCR-RO-007`).                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                               |
| **Navigation**                                          | Contouring approved → Planning; planning worklist.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      |
| **Purpose**                                             | Record the plan as a versioned object with its objectives, achieved metrics, and the trade-offs made — so that approval is an informed clinical act rather than a rubber stamp.                                                                                                                                                                         |
| **Header**                                              | Prescription strip (read-only, version-stamped); structure set version; plan version.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                   |
| **Sections**                                            | 1 Plan identification · 2 Planning inputs · 3 Beam/arc configuration · 4 Dose objectives vs achieved · 5 OAR constraints vs achieved · 6 Plan quality metrics · 7 Trade-offs and planner notes · 8 Plan sum (multi-phase) · 9 Submission for review.                                                                                                    |
| **Fields — Plan identification**                        | Plan ID and version; Prescription version used (R, read-only link); Structure set version used (R); Simulation dataset used; TPS name and version `[INTEGRATION]`; Dose calculation algorithm and version; Dose grid resolution (mm); Heterogeneity correction (Y/N); Planner; Plan created date; Plan status.                                          |
| **Fields — Beam/arc configuration**                     | Repeating per beam/arc: beam ID, modality, energy, technique, gantry angle or arc range, collimator angle, couch angle, isocentre coordinates (x, y, z), SSD, field size or MLC description, MU, weighting, wedge/accessory, bolus applied, imaging fields associated. Total MU `[DERIVED]`; number of beams/arcs; estimated delivery time `[DERIVED]`. |
| **Table — dose objectives vs achieved (exact columns)** | Structure · Objective type · Metric · Prescribed/required value · Operator · **Achieved value** · Unit · Met (Y/N) `[DERIVED]` · Deviation `[DERIVED]` · Acceptable variation applied · Comment.                                                                                                                                                        |
| **Table — OAR constraints vs achieved**                 | OAR · Constraint (type, parameter, operator, value, unit) · Constraint class (hard/optimal/acceptable) · Source protocol · **Achieved value** · Met (Y/N) `[DERIVED]` · Deviation `[DERIVED]` · **Clinical justification where exceeded** (narrative — authored by the RO, not the planner, `RO-120 [PRODUCT]`) · Prior-dose adjustment applied.        |
| **Fields — Plan quality metrics**                       | Conformity index, homogeneity index, gradient index where used `[CCA CONFIG]` — each with the definition/formula applied, since these indices have multiple definitions (`RO-130 [PRODUCT]`); Global maximum dose and its location; Hot spots outside target; Integral dose where reported.                                                             |
| **Fields — Trade-offs**                                 | Planner narrative describing compromises made; Alternative plans generated and why rejected; Constraints prioritised; Known limitations; Deliverability concerns; Notes to physics; Notes to RTT.                                                                                                                                                       |
| **Fields — Plan sum**                                   | For multi-phase courses: composite plan constructed (Y/N), method, phases included, summed dose to each OAR `[DERIVED]`, summed target coverage. **RO-140 [PRODUCT]** — where phases are additive to the same anatomy, the constraint evaluation must be performed on the summed dose, not per phase, and the screen must state which basis was used.   |
| **Calculated**                                          | Objective/constraint met flags; deviations; total MU; estimated delivery time; plan sum values; days from contour approval to plan submission `[DERIVED]`.                                                                                                                                                                                              |
| **Actions**                                             | Import plan from TPS · Refresh metrics · Add planner note · Record alternative plan · Submit for RO review · Withdraw and replan.                                                                                                                                                                                                                       |
| **Chips**                                               | Plan status (In planning / Ready for RO review / Approved by RO / QA pending / QA passed / QA failed / Released / Superseded / Rejected); constraints met/not met count; hard constraint violated (red).                                                                                                                                                |
| **Alerts**                                              | Hard stop on submission when a hard-class constraint is violated without a flagged justification request to the RO; warning when target coverage objectives are unmet; warning when the plan was built on a superseded prescription or structure set version.                                                                                           |
| **Read-only**                                           | Prescription; structure set; imported TPS values (with provenance shown per `RT-004`).                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  |
| **Amendment/version**                                   | New plan version supersedes; prior retained; QA of the prior version does not carry forward.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            |
| **Downstream**                                          | RO review queue (`SCR-RO-007`).                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                         |
| **Print/export**                                        | Planning record; DVH summary table; plan comparison report.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                             |

screens.name: RO Plan Review & Approval
screens.requirement_markdown:
## C.15.7 · `SCR-RO-007` — RO Plan Review & Approval

**Role:** Radiation Oncologist (exclusively).
**Navigation:** "Plans Awaiting My Approval" tab.
**Purpose:** The clinical decision that this plan may be delivered to this patient.
**Sections:** Prescription concordance · Target coverage · OAR constraints · Plan comparison · Clinical justification of deviations · Decision · Signature.
**Fields:** Prescription version confirmation (checkbox, R); Structure set version confirmation (checkbox, R); Per-objective review (accept/query per row); Per-constraint review (accept / accept with justification (narrative, R) / reject); Plan comparison (where alternative versions exist — side-by-side metrics); Overall clinical assessment (narrative); Decision (dropdown: Approve / Approve with conditions (conditions text, structured) / Return for replanning (reason, required changes) / Reject); Peer review required and performed (per `[CCA CONFIG]` by technique/site — reviewer, findings, outcome); Signature.
**Chips:** Approval status; peer review status; constraints accepted with justification (count).
**Alerts:** Hard stop on approving a plan built against a superseded prescription version; hard stop on approving while a hard constraint is exceeded without a written clinical justification; warning if peer review is configured as required and not performed.
**Amendment/version:** Approval is version-specific and non-transferable to any other plan version (`RT-002`).
**Downstream:** Plan state → `APPROVED BY RO`; enters physics QA queue (`SCR-PHY-001`); planning notified of returns.
**Print/export:** Plan approval record with the constraint table and justifications.

---

screens.name: Authorisation to Treat / Ready for Treatment
screens.requirement_markdown:
## C.15.8 · `SCR-RO-008` — Authorisation to Treat / Ready for Treatment

**Role:** RO (authorise); RTT (view); physics (prerequisite).
**Purpose:** The final gate before the first fraction — distinct from plan approval, because QA and scheduling intervene.
**Prerequisite checklist (all** **`[DERIVED]`****, each with source link):** Prescription signed and current; peer review complete where required; structure set approved; plan approved by RO against the current prescription version; physics QA passed and plan released; plan transferred to R&V and verified `[INTEGRATION]`; consent obtained and valid; pregnancy status confirmed where applicable; CIED management plan in place; pre-RT assessments complete (dental, nutrition, others per `[CCA CONFIG]`); setup documentation complete; treatment unit and slots booked; first fraction date set; patient informed and instructions issued; concurrent systemic therapy coordinated.
**Fields:** Authorisation decision; authorising RO; date/time; conditions; first fraction date; treating unit; notes to RTT.
**Alerts:** Hard stop on authorising with any prerequisite unmet, except those configured as overridable, each requiring individual reason.
**Downstream:** State → `READY FOR TREATMENT`; appears on the RTT unit schedule (`SCR-RTT-001`); Navigator; patient notification.
