screens.requirement_markdown:
## C.15.9 · `SCR-RO-009` — Weekly On-Treatment Review (OTV)

| Dimension Specification                           |                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    |
| ------------------------------------------------- | -------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| **Role(s)**                                       | Radiation Oncologist (primary); RT nurse (assessment components); registrar (draft + countersign).                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                 |
| **Navigation**                                    | OTV Due tab; pathway board; RTT escalation.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        |
| **Purpose**                                       | Clinical review during delivery: is the patient tolerating treatment, is delivery on track, and should the course continue unchanged.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              |
| **Header**                                        | Full RO header + delivery strip: **fraction n of m delivered**, cumulative delivered dose `[DERIVED]`, prescribed total, % complete `[DERIVED]`, elapsed treatment days `[DERIVED]`, gap days, projected completion, missed fractions.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                             |
| **Sections**                                      | 1 Delivery status · 2 Interval history · 3 Symptoms & toxicity · 4 Examination · 5 Weight & nutrition · 6 Laboratory (where concurrent therapy or indicated) · 7 Setup and imaging review · 8 Supportive care · 9 Decision · 10 Signature.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                         |
| **Fields — Delivery status (read-only, derived)** | Fractions delivered with dates; fractions missed with dates and reasons; cumulative delivered dose per phase and total (`CALC-171`); dose remaining; treatment days elapsed vs planned; gap days (`CALC-172`); projected completion date (`CALC-173`); **compensation required for gaps** `[DERIVED]` per `[CCA CONFIG]` rules with the rule named.                                                                                                                                                |
| **Fields — Interval history**                     | Auto-generated: fractions delivered since last OTV, setup deviations, out-of-tolerance images, interruptions, concurrent chemo administered, unscheduled contacts, admissions, new results. Clinician narrative on top.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            |
| **Fields — Symptoms & toxicity**                  | Site-specific acute toxicity set `[CCA CONFIG]` (e.g. for head and neck: mucositis, dysphagia, dysgeusia, xerostomia, dermatitis, pain, weight loss, aspiration; for pelvis: cystitis, proctitis, diarrhoea, dermatitis) — each graded with the grade definition displayed inline (`TOX-020`), with onset, trend and management; general symptoms; pain score and analgesia; skin assessment with photograph where captured `[CCA CONFIG]`; each entry writes to the longitudinal toxicity record. |
| **Fields — Examination**                          | Site examination; performance status; weight (R at OTV `[CCA CONFIG]`) with **cumulative weight change from baseline** `[DERIVED]` and % `[DERIVED]` (`CALC-177`) — with a configured threshold triggering nutrition referral and a re-planning consideration alert (**RO-150 [PRODUCT]**: significant weight change during RT may invalidate the plan's dosimetry; the system must flag it, not leave it to memory); nutrition status; hydration.                                                 |
| **Fields — Setup/imaging review**                 | Number of out-of-tolerance matches since last OTV; systematic shift trend `[DERIVED]` per axis; RTT concerns raised; re-simulation or re-planning indicated (Y/N + reason).                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        |
| **Fields — Supportive care**                      | Medications prescribed/changed; skin care; nutrition support; analgesia; antiemetics; referrals (dietitian, speech and language, psycho-oncology, dental); admission required.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                     |
| **Fields — Decision**                             | Decision (dropdown — product-defined: Continue unchanged / Continue with supportive measures / Interrupt — with duration and restart criteria / Modify prescription (creates a new prescription version) / Re-simulate and re-plan / Discontinue — with reason / Complete early as planned); Rationale; Next OTV date; Instructions to RTT; Instructions to nursing.                                                                                                                               |
| **Tables**                                        | Fraction delivery table (fraction, date, unit, dose delivered, imaging performed, match values, deviations, delivered by); toxicity grades over time (matrix: term × OTV date); weight trend.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      |
| **Calculated**                                    | Cumulative dose; % complete; elapsed and gap days; projected completion; weight change; toxicity grade trajectory; number of out-of-tolerance matches.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                             |
| **Actions**                                       | Record toxicity grades · Record weight · Prescribe supportive medication · Order investigations · Refer · Record decision · Amend prescription · Request re-plan · Sign · Print.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                   |
| **Chips**                                         | On track / behind schedule; gap exceeding threshold; toxicity grade ≥ threshold; weight change beyond threshold; re-plan indicated.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                |
| **Alerts**                                        | Hard stop on signing without grading the site-specific toxicity set; warning on gap days exceeding the configured limit with the compensation rule stated; warning on weight change beyond threshold; warning if OTV is overdue relative to the configured interval.                                                                                                                                                                                                                               |
| **Amendment/version**                             | Addendum only; prescription changes go through `SCR-RO-003` versioning.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            |
| **Downstream**                                    | Toxicity record; supportive prescriptions; referrals; RTT instructions; re-plan request to dosimetry; interruption record; Navigator.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              |
| **Print/export**                                  | Weekly OTV Note (Part L).                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          |

screens.name: Interruption & Gap Management
screens.requirement_markdown:
## C.15.10 · `SCR-RO-010` — Interruption & Gap Management

**Role:** RO (decide); RTT (report); scheduler.
**Fields:** Interruption start date; cause (dropdown — product-defined: Patient illness / Toxicity / Machine downtime / Patient non-attendance / Public holiday / Transport / Concurrent therapy toxicity / Admission / Clinical decision / Other); fractions missed (count and dates); gap days `[DERIVED]`; **overall treatment time to date** `[DERIVED]`; compensation policy applicable `[CCA CONFIG — CLINICAL SIGN-OFF]` (dropdown of configured strategies: no compensation / additional fractions / hyperfractionation on subsequent days / weekend treatment / dose adjustment — with the rule text displayed); compensation decision and rationale; revised schedule; revised projected completion `[DERIVED]`; patient informed; RO signature.
**RO-160 [PRODUCT]** — gap and overall-treatment-time accounting must be automatic and visible; the compensation *policy* is CCA-configured but the *tracking* is product.
**Downstream:** Schedule revision; RTT notification; completion summary records interruptions.

---

screens.name: RT Completion Summary
screens.requirement_markdown:
## C.15.11 · `SCR-RO-011` — RT Completion Summary

**Role:** RO (sign).
**Purpose:** Close the course with an auditable record of prescribed vs delivered.
**Sections:** Course identification · **Prescribed vs delivered comparison** · Delivery record · Interruptions · Toxicity at completion · Response where assessed · Follow-up plan · Signature.
**Fields — Prescribed vs delivered (per phase and total, side by side —** **`RT-003`****):** prescribed total dose vs **delivered total dose** `[DERIVED]`; prescribed fractions vs delivered fractions; prescribed dose/fraction vs mean delivered dose/fraction `[DERIVED]`; planned start/end vs actual start/end; planned overall treatment time vs actual `[DERIVED]`; completion percentage `[DERIVED]` (`CALC-178`); reason for any shortfall.
**Fields:** Technique and modality delivered; units used; number of prescription versions during the course (with delivery attributed to each); number of plan versions; total missed fractions with reasons; total gap days; compensation applied; acute toxicity at completion (graded set); interventions during course; supportive medications at completion; performance status at completion; weight at start vs completion with % change `[DERIVED]`; concurrent systemic therapy delivered (cycles, doses); complications; response assessment if performed; **follow-up plan** (first review date and by whom, imaging schedule, expected toxicity trajectory and its management, late-effect risks to monitor, red flags for the patient); patient instructions issued (version); onward referrals.
**Alerts:** Hard stop on completing while fractions remain scheduled without a documented decision; warning if delivered dose differs from prescribed by more than a configured tolerance without an explanation.
**Downstream:** Course state → `COMPLETED`; feeds the Cancer Treatment Summary (Part R); Survivorship plan late-effect section; scheduling of first RT follow-up; Navigator; MO notification.
**Print/export:** RT Completion Summary (Part L); patient completion information sheet.

screens.name: RT Follow-Up Note
screens.requirement_markdown:
## C.15.12 · `SCR-RO-012` — RT Follow-Up Note

**Sections:** Interval since completion `[DERIVED]` · Resolution of acute toxicity (graded) · Emerging late toxicity (graded, with the site-specific late-effect set `[CCA CONFIG]`) · Symptoms · Examination of the treated site · Imaging/response · Disease status · Management · Next review · Handover to surveillance owner · Signature.
**Downstream:** Toxicity record (late effects flagged as such); Survivorship plan; disease status; surveillance schedule.

# C.16 — RADIATION PHYSICS SCREENS

screens.name: Physics QA Queue
screens.requirement_markdown:
## C.16.1 · `SCR-PHY-001` — Physics QA Queue

**Role:** Physicist; physics manager.
**Columns:** Patient · UHID · Site · Technique · Prescription version · Plan version · Planner · RO approval status and timestamp · Plan submitted at · **Target first-fraction date** · Hours/days remaining `[DERIVED]` with urgency colouring · QA type required `[DERIVED]` from technique `[CCA CONFIG]` (calculation check / measurement / end-to-end / imaging QA) · Assigned physicist · Status chip (Awaiting QA / In progress / Discrepancy raised / Failed / Passed / Released) · Priority · Actions.
**Actions:** Assign to me · Open QA · Raise discrepancy · Release plan · Return to planning.
**Alerts:** QA not started with first fraction inside the configured lead time; plan submitted against a superseded prescription (`RO-080`) — displayed as a red banner and the item is blocked from QA until resolved.

screens.name: Prescription–Plan Concordance Check
screens.requirement_markdown:
## C.16.2 · `SCR-PHY-002` — Prescription–Plan Concordance Check

**Purpose:** Verify, field by field, that the plan implements the prescription.
**Table — exact columns:** Parameter · **Prescription value** (read-only, version-stamped) · **Plan value** (imported, `[INTEGRATION]`) · Match `[DERIVED]` (Y/N) · Tolerance where numeric · Deviation · Comment · Checked by · Checked at.
**Rows (minimum):** treatment site; laterality; phase; modality; technique; energy; total dose; number of fractions; dose per fraction; prescription point/normalisation; target volume names and their prescribed doses; fractions per day; patient position; immobilisation; bolus; motion management; image guidance modality and frequency; treatment unit.
**PHY-020 [PRODUCT]** — laterality and site mismatch must be a hard stop, not a warning. These are the errors that produce wrong-site treatment.
**Actions:** Import plan values · Recheck · Record mismatch · Raise discrepancy · Pass concordance.
**Alerts:** Any mismatch on a safety-critical row (site, laterality, dose, fractions, dose/fraction, technique) → hard stop and mandatory discrepancy record.

screens.name: Independent Dose / MU Verification
screens.requirement_markdown:
## C.16.3 · `SCR-PHY-003` — Independent Dose / MU Verification

**Fields:** Verification method (dropdown: independent calculation software / secondary dose algorithm / manual calculation / measurement-based) `[CCA CONFIG]`; Software name and version; Inputs used (beam data, depth, field size, SSD, wedge, heterogeneity assumption); Planned value (MU or dose at a specified point); **Independently calculated value**; Deviation `[DERIVED]` absolute and % (`CALC-180`); **Tolerance applied** `[CCA CONFIG — CLINICAL SIGN-OFF]` with its source; Result (Pass / Fail / Repeat required); Per-beam breakdown table (beam ID, planned MU, calculated MU, deviation, pass/fail); Performed by; Date/time; Comments.
**Alerts:** Deviation beyond tolerance → hard stop, discrepancy record required, planning notified.
**Read-only:** Plan and prescription content.

screens.name: Constraint & Coverage Verification
screens.requirement_markdown:
## C.16.4 · `SCR-PHY-004` — Constraint & Coverage Verification

**Table — OAR:** OAR · Constraint (type, parameter, operator, value, unit) · Class · Source protocol and version · **Achieved value** · Met `[DERIVED]` · Deviation · RO clinical justification where exceeded (read-only, authored by RO per `RO-120`) · Physicist comment · Verified by.
**Table — targets:** Volume · Coverage objective · Achieved · Met · Deviation · Comment.
**Fields:** Plan sum basis used (per phase / composite) with statement (`RO-140`); prior-dose accounting applied for re-irradiation (values, source); overall verification outcome.
**Alerts:** Hard constraint exceeded without RO justification → blocks QA pass.

screens.name: Deliverability & Machine Parameter Check
screens.requirement_markdown:
## C.16.5 · `SCR-PHY-005` — Deliverability & Machine Parameter Check

**Fields:** Treatment unit; unit capability match (energy available, MLC type, dose rate, couch limits) `[DERIVED]`; per beam/arc: gantry, collimator, couch values within machine limits (`[DERIVED]` checks), MLC leaf positions deliverable, MU within min/max per segment, dose rate, arc rotation direction and range, field size limits, jaw/MLC relationship; **collision check** (Y/N, method: virtual / physical dry run / clearance calculation, performed by, outcome); accessories required and available (wedges, blocks, applicators, bolus — with IDs); imaging fields defined; **R&V transfer verification** `[INTEGRATION]` — plan transferred, checksum/parameter comparison between TPS and R&V performed, differences found, resolved by; tolerance table applied on the machine; treatment time estimate vs slot length.
**PHY-030 [PRODUCT]** — the TPS→R&V transfer verification is a mandatory, separately recorded check, because a correct plan incorrectly transferred is delivered incorrectly.
**Alerts:** Any parameter outside machine limits → hard stop; accessory unavailable → blocked with named item.

screens.name: Patient-Specific QA Measurement
screens.requirement_markdown:
## C.16.6 · `SCR-PHY-006` — Patient-Specific QA Measurement

**Fields:** QA required (Y/N `[DERIVED]` from technique `[CCA CONFIG]`); Measurement method (dropdown: ion chamber array / film / EPID / diode array / log-file analysis / independent 3D calculation); Phantom used (ID, type); Detector (ID, calibration date, calibration valid `[DERIVED]`); Setup description; Delivery performed on which unit; Measurement date/time; Reference dataset; **Analysis criteria** (dose-difference criterion %, distance-to-agreement mm, dose threshold %, normalisation, global/local) `[CCA CONFIG — CLINICAL SIGN-OFF]`; **Result** (passing rate %, per-beam and composite); Tolerance/action levels `[CCA CONFIG]`; Outcome (Pass / Pass with note / Fail); Repeat measurements (repeating with reason and result); Performed by; Reviewed by; Comments.
**Alerts:** Detector calibration expired → hard stop; result below action level → fail, discrepancy record, planning notified.

screens.name: Discrepancy Record
screens.requirement_markdown:
## C.16.7 · `SCR-PHY-007` — Discrepancy Record

**Fields:** Discrepancy category (dropdown — product-defined: Prescription mismatch / Calculation deviation / Constraint exceeded / Deliverability / Data transfer / Imaging protocol / Documentation / Equipment / Other); Description; Severity (dropdown `[CCA CONFIG]`); Potential clinical impact; Raised by/at; Plan and prescription versions affected; Notified to (named RO/planner/manager, method, time); Response received; Root cause; Resolution action; Re-verification performed and result; Closed by/at; Incident report raised (Y/N, reference); Learning/action for practice `[CCA CONFIG]`.
**Downstream:** Planning queue; RO notification; incident register; QA cannot pass while an open discrepancy of configured severity exists.

screens.name: QA Sign-off & Plan Release
screens.requirement_markdown:
## C.16.8 · `SCR-PHY-008` — QA Sign-off & Plan Release

**Purpose:** The single gate that permits a plan to be delivered.
**Prerequisite panel (each** **`[DERIVED]`****, with link and outcome):** Prescription signed and current version; RO plan approval against that version; concordance check passed; independent dose verification passed; constraint verification passed; deliverability check passed; patient-specific QA passed (or waived with recorded authority and reason `[CCA CONFIG]`); R&V transfer verified; no open discrepancies above threshold.
**Fields:** Overall outcome; waivers applied (item, authority, reason); physicist signature (re-authenticated); release date/time; released to unit(s); release reference; notes to RTT.
**Alerts:** Hard stop on release with any unmet prerequisite lacking a recorded waiver (`PHY-181`).
**Amendment:** Release is version-specific. **PHY-040 [PRODUCT]** — a released plan cannot be modified; modification requires a new plan version, new RO approval and new QA.
**Downstream:** State → `QA PASSED / RELEASED`; enables `SCR-RO-008` authorisation; appears on RTT unit schedule.
**Print/export:** Physics QA Report (all sub-checks, values, tolerances, outcomes, signatures).

screens.name: Equipment QA Register
screens.requirement_markdown:
## C.16.9 · `SCR-PHY-009` — Equipment QA Register

**Table:** Unit · Test · Frequency (daily/weekly/monthly/annual) · Tolerance `[CCA CONFIG]` · Last performed · Result · Pass/fail · Next due `[DERIVED]` · Performed by · Action taken on failure · Downtime recorded.
**Alerts:** Overdue QA on a unit with patients scheduled → banner on the RTT unit schedule (**PHY-050 [PRODUCT]**: treatment on a unit with overdue mandatory QA must be visibly flagged to the RTT, not only to physics).

screens.name: In-Vivo Dosimetry
screens.requirement_markdown:
## C.16.10 · `SCR-PHY-010` — In-Vivo Dosimetry

**Fields:** Required (Y/N per `[CCA CONFIG]`); method; detector and calibration; fraction measured; expected dose; measured dose; deviation `[DERIVED]`; tolerance; outcome; action on out-of-tolerance; performed by; reviewed by.

# C.17 — RADIATION TECHNOLOGIST / THERAPIST SCREENS

screens.name: Treatment Unit Schedule
screens.requirement_markdown:
## C.17.1 · `SCR-RTT-001` — Treatment Unit Schedule

**Role:** RTT; unit lead; scheduler.
**Columns:** Slot time · Patient name · UHID · **Photograph** · **Treatment site and laterality (high prominence)** · Phase · **Fraction n of m** · Prescribed dose/fraction · Plan version · Plan release status `[DERIVED]` · Authorisation to treat status · Immobilisation devices required · Setup notes flag · Imaging required today `[DERIVED]` from the IGRT protocol · Preparation required (bladder/bowel/breath-hold) · Estimated slot duration · Arrival status · Status chip (Scheduled / Arrived / In room / Imaging / Delivering / Complete / Interrupted / Not treated — reason) · Special instructions · Isolation/mobility/interpreter · RO alerts · Actions.
**Screen-level alerts:** Unit QA overdue (`PHY-050`); plan not released for a scheduled patient; prescription amended since the last fraction; patient with an active RO instruction unread.
**Actions:** Open pre-treatment verification · Record arrival · Mark not treated (reason) · Escalate to RO/physics · Print unit day sheet.

screens.name: Pre-Treatment Verification
screens.requirement_markdown:
## C.17.2 · `SCR-RTT-002` — Pre-Treatment Verification

**Purpose:** The daily gate before any beam is delivered.
**Fields:** **Identity verification** (photograph displayed; minimum two identifiers, method recorded, per `MAR-007` pattern); **Site and laterality confirmation** (explicit affirmative action, displayed in large type, R — `RTT-101`); Fraction number confirmation `[DERIVED]` with mismatch hard stop (**RTT-020 [PRODUCT]**: the system computes the expected fraction number from the delivery history; an RTT-entered fraction number that disagrees halts the workflow); Prescription version current (auto-check); Plan version released (auto-check); Authorisation to treat present (auto-check); Daily preparation confirmed (bladder/bowel/fasting as applicable); Pregnancy re-check where applicable and per configured frequency `[CCA CONFIG]`; Patient condition/concerns reported today (free text + escalate action); RO instructions outstanding (displayed, acknowledged); Devices present (mask/vac-bag/etc. retrieved and IDs matched).
**Alerts:** Hard stop on any auto-check failure; hard stop on identity or fraction mismatch; warning on patient-reported new symptoms (prompts toxicity note and RO escalation).

screens.name: Setup Record
screens.requirement_markdown:
## C.17.3 · `SCR-RTT-003` — Setup Record

**Fields:** Position set as prescribed (confirm/deviation with reason); Immobilisation devices used with **index values per axis** (auto-populated from the simulation record, RTT confirms or records deviation — `RO-090`); Headrest/vac-bag/mask IDs matched (scan or manual); Couch values applied (lateral, longitudinal, vertical, rotation — numeric, with the convention stated); **Shifts from reference marks** (x, y, z in mm with explicit direction convention — `RTT-030 [PRODUCT]`: the sign convention must be displayed on screen, since sign errors are a known incident source); SSD measured; Bolus applied (type, thickness, position, confirmed); Accessories mounted (IDs); Setup photographs compared (displayed side by side with today's view where surface imaging is used); Setup performed by; Second operator verification where required `[CCA CONFIG]`; Setup deviations (description, reason, RO/physics notified).
**Alerts:** Device index differing from the simulation record → warning requiring confirmation; couch values outside the machine's stored tolerance table → hard stop.

screens.name: Verification Imaging
screens.requirement_markdown:
## C.17.4 · `SCR-RTT-004` — Verification Imaging

**Fields:** Imaging required today `[DERIVED]` from protocol; Imaging performed (Y/N + reason if not); Modality; Acquisition time; Matching structures used (from prescription); Match method (automatic / manual / auto-then-manual); **Match values per axis** (translational x/y/z in mm; rotational pitch/roll/yaw in degrees); Action level applied `[CCA CONFIG]` (displayed); Within tolerance `[DERIVED]`; **Corrective shift applied** per axis (mm/degrees); Shift applied before or after imaging; Re-imaging performed (Y/N + result); Reviewed by (RTT); **Approved by** where out of tolerance (RO or physics per the prescription's rule — named, with time); Image saved reference; Imaging dose recorded where tracked.
**Table:** Match history across fractions — fraction, date, per-axis values, tolerance, action taken — with **systematic and random deviation trends** `[DERIVED]` (`CALC-181`) surfaced for RO review at OTV.
**Alerts:** Out of tolerance → treatment blocked until the configured approver records approval; repeated out-of-tolerance across n consecutive fractions → escalation to RO and physics (`RTT-040 [PRODUCT]`: a systematic setup error must be detected by the system, not by someone noticing).

screens.name: Fraction Delivery Record
screens.requirement_markdown:
## C.17.5 · `SCR-RTT-005` — Fraction Delivery Record

**Fields:** Fraction number; date; treatment unit; plan version delivered; beams/arcs delivered (per beam: planned MU, **delivered MU** `[INTEGRATION from R&V]`, delivered Y/N); Delivery start time; Delivery end time; Delivery duration `[DERIVED]`; **Dose delivered this fraction** `[DERIVED]` (from delivered MU / R&V record — not assumed equal to prescribed, `RT-003`); Completion status (dropdown — product-defined: Complete / Partial / Aborted / Not delivered); Partial detail (beams delivered, MU delivered, **fraction of prescribed dose delivered** `[DERIVED]`, remainder disposition: deliver remainder today / add to next fraction / omit — with RO decision); Reason for partial/abort (dropdown — product-defined: patient movement / patient distress / patient request / machine fault / interlock / imaging out of tolerance / clinical decision / power failure / other + text); Actions taken; Delivered by; Second operator; RO notified (Y/N, name, time).
**Alerts:** Hard stop on recording delivery without a completion status; partial delivery triggers a mandatory RO notification and a decision record.
**Downstream:** Cumulative dose updated from actual delivery; OTV data; completion summary; scheduling adjusted if a fraction is added.

screens.name: Missed Fraction / Interruption
screens.requirement_markdown:
## C.17.6 · `SCR-RTT-006` — Missed Fraction / Interruption

**Fields:** Date; scheduled fraction number; reason (dropdown as above plus non-attendance categories); patient contacted (Y/N, by whom, outcome); RO notified; make-up plan (dropdown: next available slot / additional fraction at end / weekend / no compensation) with the configured policy displayed; rescheduled date; **gap days to date** `[DERIVED]`; **overall treatment time to date** `[DERIVED]`; impact statement.
**Downstream:** `SCR-RO-010` interruption management; schedule revision; Navigator; completion summary.

screens.name: Observed Toxicity & Patient Condition
screens.requirement_markdown:
## C.17.7 · `SCR-RTT-007` — Observed Toxicity & Patient Condition

**Fields:** Site-specific observation set `[CCA CONFIG]`; grade where the RTT is authorised to grade `[CCA CONFIG]` (otherwise descriptive only, with escalation); skin assessment with photograph; pain; weight where measured at the unit; patient-reported symptoms; nutrition/hydration concerns; escalated to (RO / RT nurse / dietitian), method, time, response.
**RTT-050 [PRODUCT]** — RTT observations write to the same longitudinal toxicity record as clinician gradings, tagged with the observer's role, so the RO sees a continuous record rather than parallel logs.

screens.name: Machine / Equipment Issue
screens.requirement_markdown:
## C.17.8 · `SCR-RTT-008` — Machine / Equipment Issue

**Fields:** Unit; issue description; category (dropdown: interlock / mechanical / imaging / dosimetry / software / accessory / environmental); time started; patients affected (list `[DERIVED]` from schedule); physics notified (name, time); action taken; resolution; downtime duration `[DERIVED]`; return-to-service authorisation (by whom, checks performed); incident reference.
**Downstream:** Physics queue; schedule reallocation; interruption records for affected patients; equipment QA register.

screens.name: Cumulative Delivery Dashboard
screens.requirement_markdown:
## C.17.9 · `SCR-RTT-009` — Cumulative Delivery Dashboard

**Purpose:** Per-patient, per-course accounting that everyone reads from.
**Displays:** Fractions delivered / prescribed; cumulative delivered dose per phase and total `[DERIVED]`; prescribed total (side by side, `RT-003`); dose remaining; elapsed treatment days; gap days; projected completion; delivery attributed by prescription version and plan version; missed fractions with reasons; out-of-tolerance imaging count; partial deliveries with amounts.
**Print/export:** Delivery record for the completion summary and the Treatment Summary.

| **Fields — Prior systemic therapy (neoadjuvant-critical)** | Repeating: regimen, cycles received, completion date, best response (link to `SCR-RSP-001`), toxicities, dose modifications, reason for stopping; **Interval since completion of last cycle** `[DERIVED]` (`CALC-191`) — displayed prominently because it governs the surgical-window discussion.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                       |
| **Fields — Prior radiotherapy**                            | Site, dose, fractionation, dates, technique, facility, **overlap with the planned surgical field** (dropdown: No overlap / Overlap — tissue-healing risk / Cannot determine) — `SO-021 [PRODUCT]`: a surgical plan proposing an incision through a previously irradiated field must display this overlap assessment before signature.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                   |
| **Fields — Prior surgery**                                 | Repeating: procedure, date, approach, findings, complications, **adhesion risk** (dropdown: Low / Moderate / High / Unknown), facility, operative note link where internal.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                             |
| **Fields — Current disease status**                        | Auto from `SCR-DX-004` (read-only) with clinician confirmation; sites of disease; resectability-relevant metastatic status.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                             |
| **Fields — Pathology reviewed**                            | Repeating: accession, date, diagnosis, grade, biomarkers, reviewed personally (Y/N) — **`SO-022 [PRODUCT]`****: the surgeon must affirmatively record having personally reviewed the histology relied upon for the operability decision, not merely that a report exists.**                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                             |
| **Fields — Imaging reviewed**                              | Repeating: study, date, modality, key findings relevant to resectability (extent, vascular involvement, nodal disease, distant disease), viewer link, reviewed personally (Y/N).                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        |
| **Fields — Symptoms**                                      | Repeating complaint (coded + free text), duration, severity, progression — shared structure with `SCR-MO-002`.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          |
| **Fields — Performance status**                            | Instrument, score, assessed by, date (distinct field from nurse-assessed PS per `MO-CON` convention).                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                   |
| **Fields — Examination**                                   | General (vitals auto-imported, read-only); systemic examination by system; **site-specific tumour examination** — measurable lesion size(s) with method and units, mobility/fixation to adjacent structures, nodal stations examined with findings, laterality.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                         |
| **Fields — Comorbidities**                                 | Coded problem list (shared `GEN-LNG-003`), auto-supplemented, with a **surgical-relevance flag** per problem (cardiac, pulmonary, renal, hepatic, diabetes, bleeding disorder, immunosuppression, prior VTE) — `SO-023 [PRODUCT]`.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      |
| **Fields — Medications / anticoagulants / antiplatelets**  | Full medication list (shared `GEN-LNG-002`) with the anticoagulant/antiplatelet sub-flag surfaced as its own reviewed panel here (not buried) — drug, last dose, indication, prescriber, **bridging consideration flagged** (Y/N + plan deferred to pre-op assessment).                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                 |
| **Fields — Allergies**                                     | Shared `GEN-LNG-001`, including latex allergy (surgically material) as a discrete, always-visible item.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                 |
| **Fields — Nutrition**                                     | Screening tool result `[CCA CONFIG]`, weight trend, albumin where available, dysphagia/intake concerns, referral to Dietitian (Y/N).                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    |
| **Fields — Anaesthetic concerns (screening only)**         | Prior anaesthesia complications (patient-reported/record); airway concerns known to date; **explicit statement that full fitness assessment is owned by Anaesthesia and not concluded here** (`SO-006`).                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                |
| **Fields — Resectability & operability**                   | Resectability assessment (dropdown — product-defined: Resectable / Borderline resectable / Unresectable — technical / Unresectable — oncological / Potentially resectable after neoadjuvant therapy, R); Operability assessment (dropdown: Operable / Operable with optimisation / Inoperable — patient factors, R); Basis (narrative, R); **`SO-024 [PRODUCT]`**: resectability (disease-based) and operability (patient-based) are captured as two distinct fields and must never be collapsed into one "fit for surgery" flag — a patient can be operable but the disease unresectable, or vice versa.                                                                                                                                                                                                               |
| **Fields — Surgical intent**                               | Dropdown (product-defined): Curative — primary / Cytoreductive / Diagnostic (biopsy/staging only) / Palliative — symptom control / Prophylactic / Reconstructive / Second-look / Salvage.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                               |
| **Fields — Proposed procedure & alternatives**             | Proposed procedure (coded from Procedure Master `[CCA CONFIG]`, R); Anatomical site; **Laterality** (R); Approach (dropdown: Open / Laparoscopic / Robotic / Thoracoscopic / Endoscopic / Other); Alternatives considered (repeating: alternative, why not chosen); Non-operative alternative discussed (Y/N + detail, R — including "no treatment").                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                   |
| **Fields — Expected benefit & risks**                      | Expected oncological benefit (narrative); Expected functional outcome; **Risks discussed** (repeating, coded + free text, each individually acknowledged — mirrors `SCR-PLN-003` risk-checklist structure); general surgical risks (bleeding, infection, VTE, anaesthetic risk, adjacent organ injury) and procedure-specific risks `[CCA CONFIG]`.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                     |
| **Fields — Reconstruction requirement**                    | Reconstruction anticipated (Y/N); type anticipated; reconstructive surgeon involvement required (Y/N + referral).                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                       |
| **Fields — Nodal strategy**                                | Planned nodal approach (dropdown: None / Sentinel node / Regional dissection — level(s) specified / Both, staged); rationale.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                           |
| **Fields — Fertility/functional implications**             | Fertility-preservation discussion (Y/N, date, outcome, referral) for the configured age band `[CCA CONFIG]` — shares the `MO-CON-030` discrete-field requirement; anticipated functional loss (e.g. continence, speech, limb function) discussed (Y/N + detail); stoma possibility discussed (Y/N — feeds `SO-025`).                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    |
| **Fields — MDT relationship**                              | Discussed at MDT already (Y/N, link); MDT discussion required before proceeding (Y/N + reason); **`SO-026 [PRODUCT]`**: where institutional pathway rules require MDT discussion before a given procedure category `[CCA CONFIG]`, the plan cannot be signed without either the MDT link or an explicit override with reason (mirrors `PLN-010`).                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                       |
| **Fields — Counselling & discussion**                      | Topics covered (multiselect `[CCA CONFIG]`); attendees; interpreter; materials issued (version); patient understanding.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                 |
| **Fields — Patient decision**                              | Dropdown (product-defined): Agreed to proceed / Agreed with modification / Wants second opinion / Declines surgery / Deferred.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          |
| **Fields — Investigations & referrals**                    | Launches `SCR-INV-001`; referrals (Anaesthesia pre-assessment, Cardiology, Pulmonology, Dietitian, Stoma nurse, Reconstructive surgery, Genetics, Fertility).                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                           |
| **Fields — Plan**                                          | Recommendation (Proceed to Surgical Plan / Neoadjuvant therapy first, re-assess / Refer to MDT / Not a surgical candidate); Target timing.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              |
| **Tables**                                                 | Chronology; prior treatments per modality; comorbidities; medications with anticoagulant sub-table; pathology reviewed; imaging reviewed; investigations/referrals raised.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              |
| **Calculated**                                             | Age; BMI; interval since neoadjuvant completion (`CALC-191`); interval since prior surgery/RT (`CALC-062`/analogue); PS trend.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          |
| **Actions**                                                | Save draft · Insert template `[CCA CONFIG]` · Import previous note · Order investigations · Refer (Anaesthesia/Dietitian/Stoma/Reconstructive/Genetics/Fertility) · Submit to MDT · **Create Surgical Plan** · Print · Sign.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            |
| **Chips**                                                  | Section completion; resectability; operability; MDT status; site/laterality (persistent); draft/signed.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                 |
| **Alerts**                                                 | **Hard stop on sign:** no resectability assessment; no operability assessment; no site/laterality recorded; no allergy status. **Warning:** MDT required by pathway rule and not linked; anticoagulant/antiplatelet present without a bridging-consideration flag; fertility discussion not recorded within the configured age band; prior RT overlap flagged without narrative.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        |
| **Conditional logic**                                      | Reconstruction sub-fields appear when reconstruction anticipated; nodal strategy fields by disease site `[CCA CONFIG]`; fertility panel by age/sex; MDT-required panel by pathway rule.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                 |
| **Read-only**                                              | Vitals, labs, imaging, prior notes, all derived values, cancer chronology object.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                       |
| **Sign/approve**                                           | Surgeon signature with re-authentication; trainee draft requires consultant countersignature to become consumable.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      |
| **Amendment/version**                                      | Addendum/amendment with reason; prior version viewable; consumers notified where intent or procedure changes.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                           |
| **Comparison view**                                        | Previous surgical consultation of the same episode, section-aligned.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    |
| **Post-signature**                                         | Note immutable; resectability/operability/intent written to episode; "Create Surgical Plan" unlocked; referrals dispatched.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                             |
| **Downstream queues**                                      | `SCR-SO-003` Surgical Plan creation; Anaesthesia referral queue; Dietitian/Stoma/Reconstructive/Genetics/Fertility queues; MDT submission inbox.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        |
| **Blocked state**                                          | Cannot sign without an active cancer episode; cannot create a plan proposing a procedure inconsistent with a signed active Treatment Plan's surgical component without an off-plan reason (`PLN-030` pattern).                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          |
| **Print/export**                                           | Surgical Oncology Consultation Note (full sections per Part F); referral letters derived from it.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                       |
