screens.requirement_markdown:
## C.18.3 · `SCR-SO-003` — Surgical Plan

*Exceptional depth. This is the authorising object for the intended operation, structurally parallel to* *`SCR-RO-003`* *(RT Prescription).*

| Dimension Specification                                                  |                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                   |
| ------------------------------------------------------------------------ | ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| **Role(s)**                                                              | Surgical Oncologist (create, edit, sign — exclusively); everyone else read-only.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  |
| **Navigation**                                                           | From `SCR-SO-002` → "Create Surgical Plan"; from Treatment Plan surgical component → "Convert to Surgical Plan"; Surgical worklist → Open plan.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                   |
| **Purpose**                                                              | Define, in structured form, exactly what operation is authorised, on whom, on what site, with what resources — the object the entire pre-operative pathway gates against.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                         |
| **Header**                                                               | Full surgical header + plan strip: plan version, status, procedure (short name), site & laterality (persistent, high prominence), intent, priority, target date, signed by/at.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    |
| **Sections**                                                             | 1 Diagnosis & stage snapshot · 2 Intent & priority · 3 Procedure definition · 4 Approach & extent · 5 Nodal procedure · 6 Reconstruction · 7 Multidisciplinary surgical involvement · 8 Timing · 9 Pre-op investigations & imaging required · 10 Anaesthesia & blood requirements · 11 ICU/HDU planning · 12 Implants & special equipment · 13 Frozen section & specimen handling instructions · 14 Stoma possibility · 15 Consent requirement · 16 Version & signature.                                          |
| **Fields — Diagnosis & stage snapshot (read-only, frozen at signature)** | Site, laterality, histology, grade, cTNM, pTNM where already available, biomarkers, disease status, line of therapy, neoadjuvant status and completion date/interval.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                             |
| **Fields — Intent & priority**                                           | Surgical intent (from consultation, confirmable); Priority (dropdown — product-defined: Elective — routine / Elective — expedited / Urgent / Emergency); Priority reason (R when not Elective — routine).                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                         |
| **Fields — Procedure definition**                                        | **Procedure** (coded from Procedure Master `[CCA CONFIG]`, R); Procedure short name (auto, editable); **Anatomical site** (coded, R); **Laterality** (R, product-defined value set: Left / Right / Bilateral / Midline / Not applicable); Proposed extent (dropdown/text per procedure type `[CCA CONFIG]` — e.g. segmental / total / partial / radical, with the value set scoped to the selected procedure); Second/staged procedure (Y/N, with the relationship to this plan specified — e.g. "Stage 1 of 2"). |
| **Fields — Approach & extent**                                           | Approach (dropdown: Open / Laparoscopic / Robotic / Thoracoscopic / Endoscopic / Hybrid / Other); Planned conversion threshold/criteria (narrative, optional); Estimated duration (numeric, minutes); Estimated blood loss category `[CCA CONFIG]` (for resource planning, distinct from the actual intra-operative value recorded later).                                                                                                                                                                        |
| **Fields — Nodal procedure**                                             | Planned nodal approach (None / Sentinel node biopsy / Regional lymphadenectomy — level(s) / Both — staged); Node stations planned (multiselect, coded).                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                           |
| **Fields — Reconstruction**                                              | Reconstruction planned (Y/N); Type (dropdown `[CCA CONFIG]`); Reconstruction surgeon (named, distinct from primary surgeon where a joint case); Timing (Immediate / Delayed — with planned interval).                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                             |
| **Fields — Multidisciplinary surgical involvement**                      | Joint procedure (Y/N); Other surgical specialties involved (multiselect: Plastic/Reconstructive, Vascular, Urology, Gynaecology, ENT, Neurosurgery, Orthopaedic, Cardiothoracic, Other) with named surgeon per specialty and their role in the case.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              |
| **Fields — Timing**                                                      | Expected date (date, editable); Post-neoadjuvant minimum interval check `[DERIVED]` (`CALC-191` compared against `[CCA CONFIG]` minimum, with override + reason where violated — `SO-030 [PRODUCT]`); Target interval from decision to surgery `[CCA CONFIG]` with countdown `[DERIVED]`.                                                                                                                                                                                                                         |
| **Fields — Pre-op investigations & imaging required**                    | Auto-assembled required set from Procedure Master + anaesthesia-driven standard set `[CCA CONFIG]`, each launchable to `SCR-INV-001`, with status `[DERIVED]`.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    |
| **Fields — Anaesthesia & blood requirements**                            | Anticipated anaesthesia type (dropdown: General / Regional / Local + sedation / Combined); Anaesthesia referral raised (Y/N, auto); **Blood product requirement** (dropdown: None anticipated / Group & save / Crossmatch — n units, R); rationale where crossmatch requested.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    |
| **Fields — ICU/HDU planning**                                            | Anticipated post-op level of care (dropdown: Ward / HDU / ICU — planned / ICU — contingency); bed request raised (Y/N, auto-notification to bed management).                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      |
| **Fields — Implants & special equipment**                                | Repeating: item category (Mesh / Prosthesis / Expander / Fiducial marker / Energy device / Robotic platform / Other), specific item where known, availability confirmed (Y/N), special equipment request routed to theatre stores.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                |
| **Fields — Frozen section & specimen handling**                          | Frozen section anticipated (Y/N); Anticipated question (e.g. margin assessment, nodal status); Specimen handling/orientation instructions to pathology (structured + free text, R when non-standard — `SO-031 [PRODUCT]`: orientation instructions must be a structured field consumable by the pathology accession screen, not only prose in the operative note).                                                                                                                                                |
| **Fields — Stoma possibility**                                           | Stoma possible (Y/N); If yes — stoma-site marking required pre-operatively (Y/N, auto-creates a Stoma Nurse referral task, `SO-032 [PRODUCT]`).                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                   |
| **Fields — Consent requirement**                                         | Required consent type(s) (auto from procedure + `[CCA CONFIG]`) with status per consent (from `SCR-SO-005`).                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      |
| **Tables**                                                               | Multidisciplinary involvement (specialty, surgeon, role); pre-op investigations required with status; implants/equipment requested with availability; version history.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            |
| **Dropdowns**                                                            | Procedure (Procedure Master `[CCA CONFIG]`); site, laterality, approach, priority, level of care (product-defined backbones + `[CCA CONFIG]` extensions).                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                         |
| **Calculated**                                                           | Interval since neoadjuvant completion (`CALC-191`); target-interval countdowns; pre-op investigation completeness `[DERIVED]`.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    |
| **Actions**                                                              | Import from Treatment Plan surgical component · Save draft · Add specialty involvement · Order pre-op investigations (pre-filled) · Request consent capture · Request anaesthesia referral · Request blood product · Notify bed management · Print plan summary · **Sign** · Create new version.                                                                                                                                                                                                                  |
| **Chips**                                                                | Plan status (Draft / Active / Superseded / Completed / Abandoned); investigation completeness; consent status; anaesthesia-referral status; blood-request status.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                 |
| **Alerts**                                                               | **Hard stop on sign:** no procedure selected; no site/laterality; intent inconsistent with recorded stage without override `[CCA CONFIG]`. **Warning:** scheduling inside the configured minimum post-neoadjuvant interval; blood product requested without a crossmatch order raised; stoma possible without a marking referral raised; joint procedure without all named specialties confirmed.                                                                                                                 |
| **Conditional logic**                                                    | Reconstruction sub-section renders only when reconstruction planned; nodal sub-section by disease site `[CCA CONFIG]`; ICU/HDU fields expand by anticipated level of care.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        |
| **Read-only**                                                            | Diagnosis/stage snapshot; Procedure Master content; derived intervals.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            |
| **Sign/approve**                                                         | Surgeon signature with re-authentication. Where the plan involves multiple specialties, each named specialty surgeon's acknowledgement is recorded (co-acknowledgement, not co-authorship) — `SO-033 [PRODUCT]`, mirroring `PLN-020`.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                             |
| **Amendment/version**                                                    | Any clinically meaningful change creates **Version n+1**; prior version retained, viewable, `SUPERSEDED`. Version in force at scheduling/consent time is stamped on those records. Version change requires reason (dropdown: response to neoadjuvant / new information / patient choice / resource availability / error correction / MDT re-discussion).                                                                                                                                                          |
| **Comparison view**                                                      | Version diff (field · version A · version B · changed · reason · changed by/at), per `SCR-PLN-002` pattern.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                       |
| **Post-signature**                                                       | Plan becomes the authority for pre-op ordering, consent, scheduling and the theatre readiness gate; `SCR-SO-006` scheduling screen can only book against an active plan version.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  |
| **Downstream queues**                                                    | Pre-op investigation ordering; Anaesthesia referral; Blood Bank request; Consent task (`SCR-SO-005`); Scheduling (`SCR-SO-006`); Stoma nurse marking referral; Theatre stores (implants/equipment).                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                               |
| **Blocked**                                                              | No active episode; no signed Surgical Consultation; procedure inconsistent with active Treatment Plan surgical component without off-plan reason.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                 |
| **Print/export**                                                         | Surgical Plan (clinical); Patient Surgical Plan Summary (lay version); pre-op investigation order pack.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                           |

## C.18.4 · `SCR-SO-004` — Pre-operative Assessment / Workup

| Dimension Specification                                                                                              |                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                               |
| -------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- | --------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| **Role(s)**                                                                                                          | Surgical Oncologist / registrar (review, complete); Anaesthetist (own sub-record, read-only here per `SO-006`); nursing (data collection support).                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            |
| **Navigation**                                                                                                       | Surgical Plan → "Pre-op workup"; Pathway board → "Workup" tab; from `SCR-SO-006` scheduling gate.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                             |
| **Purpose**                                                                                                          | Aggregate every fact needed to confirm the patient is ready for the planned operation, drawing from owning-role records rather than re-collecting them.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                       |
| **Header**                                                                                                           | Full surgical header, with Surgical Plan strip (version, procedure, site/laterality) and a **workup completeness gauge** `[DERIVED]`.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                         |
| **Sections**                                                                                                         | 1 Pre-op H&P summary · 2 Interval clinical change · 3 Latest imaging/pathology · 4 Current stage · 5 Neoadjuvant treatment & completion · 6 Toxicity from neoadjuvant therapy · 7 Comorbidities & medications · 8 Anticoagulation plan · 9 Allergies · 10 Laboratory · 11 Blood group / crossmatch (read-only import) · 12 Anaesthesia fitness (read-only import) · 13 Cardiac/pulmonary evaluation (read-only import where separately owned) · 14 Nutritional status · 15 Infection status · 16 Pregnancy status where applicable · 17 Consent status (read-only link) · 18 Site/laterality re-confirmation · 19 Fasting instruction · 20 VTE prophylaxis plan · 21 Antibiotic prophylaxis plan · 22 Stoma site marking status · 23 Blood availability status · 24 Implants/equipment confirmation · 25 Overall readiness conclusion & sign. |
| **Fields — Interval clinical change**                                                                                | Since the surgical consultation/plan: new symptoms, weight change, functional status change, new results, any change to disease status (auto-listed, clinician narrative on top — `MO-CON-060` pattern).                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      |
| **Fields — Latest imaging/pathology**                                                                                | Auto-linked with dates; flag if imaging predates the operation by more than a configured validity window `[CCA CONFIG]` (staleness per `GEN-DSP-003`).                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        |
| **Fields — Current stage**                                                                                           | cTNM (and pTNM if already available) read-only from `SCR-DX-002`.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                             |
| **Fields — Neoadjuvant treatment & completion**                                                                      | Regimen, cycles, completion date, **interval since completion** `[DERIVED]` (`CALC-191`, re-displayed here as the safety-critical figure it is), best response, ongoing toxicity.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                             |
| **Fields — Toxicity from neoadjuvant therapy**                                                                       | Active toxicities relevant to surgical fitness (e.g. neutropenia, thrombocytopenia, cardiotoxicity, wound-healing-relevant agents such as anti-angiogenics with a **required washout interval** `[CCA CONFIG]` — `SO-040 [PRODUCT]`: where the last systemic agent carries a configured pre-operative washout requirement, the screen must compute and display days-since-last-dose against that requirement and hard-stop scheduling confirmation if unmet without an override).                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                             |
| **Fields — Comorbidities & medications**                                                                             | Shared lists, surgically-relevant flags surfaced; full medication reconciliation status.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      |
| **Fields — Anticoagulation plan**                                                                                    | Drug; last dose date/time; **bridging plan** (dropdown: No bridging required / Bridging with [agent] / Continue through surgery — low-risk procedure / Specialist-directed plan, with specialist named); planned stop date; **planned restart date and criteria** (R — `SO-041 [PRODUCT]`: an anticoagulation plan without both a stop and a restart plan is incomplete and blocks readiness).                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                |
| **Fields — Allergies**                                                                                               | Shared `GEN-LNG-001`, latex status explicit.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  |
| **Fields — Laboratory**                                                                                              | Full blood count, coagulation profile, renal function, liver function, electrolytes, group & save/crossmatch result — each value, unit, date, flag, staleness chip against a configured freshness window `[CCA CONFIG]`.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      |
| **Fields — Blood group / crossmatch (read-only import from Blood Bank per** **`BLD-010`****)**                       | Blood group; antibody screen result; crossmatch status; units held; expiry of crossmatch validity `[DERIVED]`.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                |
| **Fields — Anaesthesia fitness (read-only import from Anaesthetist's Pre-anaesthesia Assessment,** **`B.21.8`****)** | ASA grade or equivalent `[CCA CONFIG]`; fitness decision (Fit / Fit with optimisation / Not fit); required optimisation and re-review date where applicable; airway assessment summary; anaesthetic plan reference. **`SO-006`** **applies: this panel is never editable from Surgical Oncology.**                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            |
| **Fields — Cardiac/pulmonary evaluation**                                                                            | ECG, echocardiogram/LVEF, pulmonary function test results where ordered, each with date and read-only source.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                 |
| **Fields — Nutritional status**                                                                                      | Screening score, weight trend, albumin, Dietitian input where referred.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                       |
| **Fields — Infection status**                                                                                        | Active infection screen; MRSA/other colonisation status `[CCA CONFIG]`; temperature trend.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    |
| **Fields — Pregnancy status**                                                                                        | Status, test result, test date, where applicable by sex/age.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  |
| **Fields — Consent status**                                                                                          | Read-only chip from `SCR-SO-005` with link.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                   |
| **Fields — Site/laterality re-confirmation**                                                                         | Explicit affirmative re-confirmation action, distinct from the plan's original entry (`SO-002`).                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              |
| **Fields — Fasting instruction**                                                                                     | Instruction issued (Y/N), fasting window `[CCA CONFIG]`, patient confirmed understanding.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                     |
| **Fields — VTE prophylaxis plan**                                                                                    | Mechanical (Y/N + device), pharmacological (agent, dose, timing) `[CCA CONFIG — CLINICAL SIGN-OFF]` for the actual protocol content; the *field structure* is `[PRODUCT]`.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    |
| **Fields — Antibiotic prophylaxis plan**                                                                             | Agent, dose, timing relative to incision `[CCA CONFIG]`.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      |
| **Fields — Stoma site marking status**                                                                               | Read-only from Stoma Nurse record; marked (Y/N), site, marked by, date.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                       |
| **Fields — Blood availability status**                                                                               | `[DERIVED]` roll-up of the Blood Bank panel into a single readiness chip.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                     |
| **Fields — Implants/equipment confirmation**                                                                         | Read-only roll-up from `SCR-SO-003` implant/equipment requests, availability status.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          |
| **Fields — Overall readiness conclusion**                                                                            | Dropdown: Ready for theatre / Ready with conditions (named) / Not ready — optimisation required (with plan and re-review date) / Cancel/postpone (with reason).                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                               |
| **Tables**                                                                                                           | Laboratory results; medication reconciliation; anticoagulation timeline; pre-op investigation status.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                         |
| **Calculated**                                                                                                       | Interval since neoadjuvant completion; washout-interval compliance (`SO-040`); staleness of every imported value against configured windows; overall readiness completeness gauge `[DERIVED]`.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                |
| **Actions**                                                                                                          | Refresh imports · Order missing investigation · Request anaesthesia re-review · Request blood product · Request stoma marking · Record readiness conclusion · Print pre-op summary · Sign.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    |
| **Chips**                                                                                                            | Per-domain readiness (green/amber/red); overall readiness; staleness per value.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                               |
| **Alerts**                                                                                                           | **Hard stop:** anaesthesia fitness = Not fit and no re-review scheduled; crossmatch requested but not held with valid expiry; consent not current; site/laterality not reconfirmed. **Override with reason:** neoadjuvant washout interval unmet; scheduling inside minimum post-neoadjuvant interval. **Warning:** any imported value stale beyond its freshness window; nutrition screening flags high risk without a Dietitian referral.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                   |
| **Conditional logic**                                                                                                | Pregnancy panel by sex/age; cardiac/pulmonary panel by procedure risk category `[CCA CONFIG]`; stoma panel only when the plan flags stoma possibility.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        |
| **Read-only**                                                                                                        | All Anaesthesia, Blood Bank and Dietitian imports; all lab/imaging values; Procedure Master content.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          |
| **Sign/approve**                                                                                                     | Surgical Oncologist (or delegated registrar with countersignature) signs the readiness conclusion. This signature does **not** substitute for the Theatre Safety Gate (`SCR-SO-008`), which is a same-day, separate gate.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                     |
| **Amendment/version**                                                                                                | Re-assessment creates a new dated entry; prior entries retained.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              |
| **Downstream**                                                                                                       | Feeds pathway-board "Workup complete" state; feeds `SCR-SO-006` scheduling gate; feeds `SCR-SO-008` Theatre Safety Gate pre-population.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                       |
| **Blocked**                                                                                                          | No signed Surgical Plan.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      |
| **Print/export**                                                                                                     | Pre-operative Assessment Summary.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                             |

## C.18.5 · `SCR-SO-005` — Surgical Consent

*Extends the generic Consent Capture object (**`SCR-PLN-003`**) with surgery-specific structure. Not a restatement — this screen independently specifies every field a UX designer needs.*

| Dimension Specification                                |                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                   |
| ------------------------------------------------------ | ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| **Role(s)**                                            | Surgical Oncologist (obtain, sign as clinician); nurse (witness where configured); patient/legal representative (sign).                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                           |
| **Navigation**                                         | Surgical Plan → "Obtain consent"; Pathway board → Consent tab; Pre-op workup → Consent status link.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                               |
| **Purpose**                                            | Capture procedure-specific informed consent as a versioned artifact bound to the exact Surgical Plan version it authorises — never a free-floating "surgery consent".                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                             |
| **Header**                                             | Full surgical header; persistent Site/Laterality strip; linked Surgical Plan version banner.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      |
| **Sections**                                           | 1 Procedure identification · 2 Risks discussed · 3 Benefits & alternatives · 4 Reconstruction/nodal/stoma-specific consent items · 5 Blood product consent · 6 Anaesthesia consent cross-reference · 7 Capacity & consent-giver · 8 Interpreter & materials · 9 Site/laterality reconfirmation · 10 Signatures · 11 Withdrawal.                                                                                                                                                                                                                   |
| **Fields — Procedure identification**                  | Consent type (dropdown `[CCA CONFIG]` — e.g. "Consent for Operation/Procedure"); Template + version (auto, R/O); **Procedure/Surgical Plan version consented to** (auto-linked, non-editable — `SO-042 [PRODUCT]`, direct extension of `PLN-040`); Site & laterality (auto from plan, **independently reconfirmed by the consenting clinician via explicit action**, `SO-002`); Planned extent as stated to patient (auto-populated text from the plan, editable only via plan amendment, not here).                                              |
| **Fields — Risks discussed**                           | Checklist from template `[CCA CONFIG]`, each individually acknowledged: general surgical risks (bleeding requiring transfusion, infection, VTE, anaesthetic risk, scarring, adjacent-organ injury, death) and procedure-specific risks `[CCA CONFIG]`; each item: discussed (Y/N), specific detail given (free text where non-standard).                                                                                                                                                                                                          |
| **Fields — Benefits & alternatives**                   | Expected benefit (auto from consultation, editable); Alternatives discussed including no treatment (R); Alternative treatment modalities discussed (checklist: non-operative management, different extent, different approach).                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                   |
| **Fields — Reconstruction/nodal/stoma-specific items** | Reconstruction consent sub-item (where applicable) — type, risks specific to reconstruction, alternative reconstruction options declined; Nodal procedure consent sub-item — risks (lymphoedema etc. `[CCA CONFIG]`); **Possibility of stoma** — explicit consent item where the plan flags stoma possibility (Y/N, discussed, patient understanding) — `SO-043 [PRODUCT]`: consent for a procedure that carries a stoma possibility must contain a discrete, individually-acknowledged stoma item, never assumed covered by a general risk list. |
| **Fields — Blood product consent**                     | Consent to blood product administration if required (Y/N); alternatives to transfusion discussed where relevant (e.g. cell salvage `[CCA CONFIG]`); specific objection recorded (e.g. on religious grounds) with the resulting clinical plan cross-referenced to `SCR-SO-003`.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    |
| **Fields — Anaesthesia consent cross-reference**       | Read-only status chip confirming Anaesthesia's own consent (owned by Anaesthetist, `B.21.8`) is separately obtained — **not duplicated here** (`SO-006`), only referenced.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        |
| **Fields — Capacity & consent-giver**                  | Capacity assessed (Y/N, assessor, basis); Consent given by (Patient / Legal representative — relationship + authority basis); Emergency consent exception invoked (Y/N + two-clinician justification where used `[CCA CONFIG]`).                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  |
| **Fields — Interpreter & materials**                   | Interpreter used (Y/N, name/service, language); Information material issued (version); Questions answered (Y/N + summary).                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        |
| **Fields — Site/laterality reconfirmation**            | Distinct, timestamped, explicit affirmative action separate from the auto-populated display (`SO-002`) — this is the second of the five reconfirmation checkpoints.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                               |
| **Fields — Signatures**                                | Patient/representative signature (capture); Clinician name/signature; Witness (conditional per `[CCA CONFIG]`); Date/time; Validity period `[CCA CONFIG]`.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        |
| **Fields — Withdrawal**                                | Withdrawal date, reason, recorded by — a new event, never a deletion (`REG-FD-090` pattern).                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      |
| **Tables**                                             | Risk acknowledgement checklist; consent version history; linked Surgical Plan version history.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    |
| **Chips**                                              | Consent status (Not required / Pending / Obtained / Expired / Withdrawn / Declined); template currency; plan-version currency (flags if the linked Surgical Plan has since been superseded — `SO-044 [PRODUCT]`: consent obtained against a superseded plan version is flagged and re-consent is required before scheduling proceeds).                                                                                                                                                                                                            |
| **Alerts**                                             | **Hard stop:** consent obtained against a plan version that has since changed materially (procedure, site or laterality changed) without re-consent; site/laterality mismatch between plan and consent. **Warning:** consent template superseded since capture; capacity not assessed for a patient flagged at risk `[CCA CONFIG]`.                                                                                                                                                                                                               |
| **Downstream**                                         | Consent chip on pathway board, pre-op workup, scheduling and theatre safety gate; readiness criterion for `SCR-SO-006` and `SCR-SO-008`.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          |
| **Print/export**                                       | Signed consent form (patient copy + record copy), with the linked plan version stated on the printed document.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    |
