## C.18.7 · `SCR-SO-007` — Pre-operative H&P / Day-of-Surgery Review

| Dimension Specification  |                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              |
| ------------------------ | -------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| **Role(s)**              | Surgical Oncologist / registrar.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                             |
| **Navigation**           | Operating list row → "Pre-op H&P"; ward admission for surgery.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                               |
| **Purpose**              | The final clinical checkpoint before the patient enters theatre, distinct from the workup (`SCR-SO-004`, which may be days old) and from the Theatre Safety Gate (`SCR-SO-008`, which is a checklist, not a clinical assessment).                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            |
| **Header**               | Full surgical header; Site/Laterality strip; admission strip (ward, bed, admission time).                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    |
| **Sections**             | 1 Interval change since workup · 2 Focused examination · 3 Vitals & weight today · 4 Fasting confirmation · 5 Bowel/bladder preparation confirmation (where applicable) · 6 Site/laterality reconfirmation (3rd checkpoint) · 7 Consent reconfirmation · 8 Medication given today (pre-op meds, anticoagulant status) · 9 Outstanding results check · 10 Final fitness confirmation · 11 Sign.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                               |
| **Fields**               | Interval history since pre-op workup (any new symptom, event, admission — narrative + auto event list); Focused examination relevant to the planned procedure and to anaesthesia; Vitals and weight today (imported, with delta from workup); Fasting confirmed (time last ate/drank, R); Bowel/bladder preparation confirmed where the procedure requires it `[CCA CONFIG]`; **Site/laterality reconfirmation** (explicit affirmative action, R — checkpoint 3 of 5); Consent reconfirmed present and unaltered since capture; Anticoagulant last-dose status re-checked against the bridging plan; Outstanding results check (any pending investigation that could change the decision — `SO-047 [PRODUCT]`: a critical result received after workup but before surgery must surface here as a blocking item, not remain only in the results inbox); Final fitness confirmation (dropdown: Proceed / Postpone — reason / Cancel — reason). |
| **Calculated**           | Time since last fasting intake `[DERIVED]`; interval since workup.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                           |
| **Actions**              | Confirm proceed · Postpone (reason, reschedule) · Cancel (reason) · Escalate to anaesthesia/senior surgeon · Sign.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                           |
| **Chips**                | Fitness-to-proceed; site/laterality reconfirmed (green once done); outstanding-result flag.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  |
| **Alerts**               | **Hard stop:** site/laterality not reconfirmed; fasting not confirmed; a critical unacknowledged result exists. **Warning:** interval change suggests deterioration; anticoagulant status inconsistent with the bridging plan.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                               |
| **Sign/approve**         | Surgeon (or registrar with countersignature) signs the final go/no-go decision.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              |
| **Downstream**           | Proceed → unlocks `SCR-SO-008` Theatre Safety Gate; postpone/cancel → returns to `SCR-SO-006` with reason, notifies theatre/anaesthesia/blood bank to release reserved resources.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            |
| **Print/export**         | Pre-operative H&P / Day-of-Surgery Review Note.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              |

screens.requirement_markdown:
## C.18.8 · `SCR-SO-008` — Theatre Readiness / Surgical Safety Gate

*The final, same-day, three-phase gate before, during and at the close of the operation. Structure is* *`[PRODUCT]`**; the institution's exact checklist wording is* *`[CCA CONFIG — CLINICAL SIGN-OFF]`**.*

| Dimension Specification                                                                         |                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  |
| ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- | -------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| **Role(s)**                                                                                     | Surgeon, Anaesthetist, Scrub/Circulating nurse — **each phase requires the affirmative participation of a defined role combination**, not one person completing the form alone.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  |
| **Navigation**                                                                                  | From `SCR-SO-007` "Proceed"; theatre reception; auto-launched on patient arrival in the operating room per theatre workflow integration `[CCA CONFIG]`.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          |
| **Purpose**                                                                                     | A three-phase, team-verified, time-stamped safety checklist gating anaesthesia induction, incision, and the end of the procedure — the surgical analogue of the Day Care gate sequence (`MAR-001`) and the RTT pre-treatment verification (`RTT-020`).                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                           |
| **Header**                                                                                      | Patient photograph (large); name, UHID, DOB; **Site & laterality** (maximum visual prominence — checkpoint 4 of 5, `SO-002`); planned procedure; theatre; team roster for today's case.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          |
| **Sections/phases**                                                                             | **Phase 1 — Sign In** (before induction of anaesthesia) · **Phase 2 — Time Out** (before skin incision) · **Phase 3 — Sign Out** (before the patient leaves the operating room).                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                 |
| **Fields — Sign In (product-defined structure,** **`[CCA CONFIG]`** **for exact item wording)** | Identity confirmed (patient states name/DOB or two-identifier method, R); **Site and laterality confirmed by the patient/representative where possible and marked on the patient** (R — hard stop if unmarked where marking is required for the procedure type `[CCA CONFIG]`); Consent confirmed present and correct; Anaesthesia safety check completed (owned by Anaesthetist — read-only reference here, `SO-006`); Allergy status confirmed; Difficult airway/aspiration risk assessed (owned by Anaesthetist); Blood loss risk assessed and blood availability confirmed where required; Pulse oximeter functioning and on patient. Each item: confirmed by (role), time.                                                                                                                                                                                                  |
| **Fields — Time Out (before incision)**                                                         | **All team members introduce themselves by name and role** (R, team roster confirmed); Surgeon, Anaesthetist and Nurse **verbally confirm patient identity, site, laterality and procedure** (R, each role individually attests — `SO-048 [PRODUCT]`: Time Out site/laterality confirmation must record three independent attestations, one per role, not a single shared checkbox); Anticipated critical events reviewed (surgeon: critical/unexpected steps, operative duration, anticipated blood loss; anaesthetist: patient-specific concerns; nursing: sterility/equipment confirmation including indicator results); Antibiotic prophylaxis given within the required window confirmed (Y/N + time, `[DERIVED]` window check against `[CCA CONFIG]`); Essential imaging displayed (Y/N, where relevant); VTE prophylaxis confirmed. Each item: confirmed by (role), time. |
| **Fields — Sign Out (before leaving OR)**                                                       | Procedure performed recorded (name of procedure actually done — first capture of the **actual** procedure, feeding the Operative Note, `SO-001`); Instrument, sponge/swab and needle counts confirmed correct **or** discrepancy resolution recorded (R — `SO-010`, `SO-049 [PRODUCT]`: a Sign-Out cannot close with an unresolved count discrepancy; resolution options are structured: re-count and resolved / imaging performed and result / accepted by surgeon with reason and follow-up plan); Specimen labelling confirmed (specimen name matched to patient, matched to orientation instructions, R); Equipment problems to be addressed identified; Key concerns for recovery and management reviewed by surgeon, anaesthetist and nurse. Each item: confirmed by (role), time.                                                                                         |
| **Tables**                                                                                      | Team roster (name, role, arrival/departure time — mirrors MDT attendance pattern `MDT-040`); count record (item type, count 1, count 2, match Y/N, discrepancy action).                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          |
| **Calculated**                                                                                  | Antibiotic-timing compliance `[DERIVED]`; phase completion percentage; time between phases.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      |
| **Actions**                                                                                     | Start Sign In · Complete Sign In · Start Time Out · Complete Time Out · Start Sign Out · Complete Sign Out · Record discrepancy · Escalate.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      |
| **Chips**                                                                                       | Phase status (Not started / In progress / Complete); count status (Correct / Discrepancy — resolved / Discrepancy — unresolved, persistent red until resolved).                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  |
| **Alerts**                                                                                      | **Hard stop:** Time Out not completed before an incision-timestamp is recorded in the Operative Note (`SO-050 [PRODUCT]`: the system cross-checks the Operative Note's incision time against Time Out completion time and blocks note signature if incision precedes Time Out); Sign Out count discrepancy unresolved at note signature.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                         |
| **Sign/approve**                                                                                | Each phase is jointly attested by the required roles (structured multi-party confirmation, not a single signature) — extension of `GEN-AUD-004`'s two-distinct-identity principle to a three-party checklist.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    |
| **Downstream**                                                                                  | Feeds Operative Note header (team, timings, actual procedure name, count outcome) — **not re-typed** (`SO-051 [PRODUCT]`, mirrors `MAR-026`).                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    |
| **Blocked**                                                                                     | Cannot start Sign In without a "Proceed" decision on `SCR-SO-007`. Cannot start Time Out without Sign In complete. Cannot start Sign Out without Time Out complete.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              |
| **Print/export**                                                                                | Surgical Safety Checklist record (all three phases, timestamps, attestations).                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                   |
