## C.18.9 · `SCR-SO-009` — Detailed Operative Note

*Maximum depth in this section by explicit instruction. This is the authoritative record of what was actually done, structurally parallel in rigor to* *`SCR-RO-003`* *(RT Prescription) and* *`SCR-ORD-002`* *(Dosing Panel), and is the pivot on which* *`GEN-CMP-001`* *(planned vs actual) and* *`SO-004`* *(specimen traceability) both depend.*

| Dimension Specification                                                                                            |                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                     |
| ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------ | ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| **Role(s)**                                                                                                        | Primary surgeon (author, sign — exclusively); assistant surgeon(s) (co-author entries, no independent sign unless co-surgeon per `[CCA CONFIG]`); anaesthetist, scrub/circulating nurse (contribute their own sections, separately attributed); everyone else read-only once signed.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                |
| **Navigation**                                                                                                     | From Theatre Safety Gate Sign-Out complete; Pathway board → "Open operative note"; cannot be opened before Time Out is complete (`SO-050`).                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                         |
| **Purpose**                                                                                                        | Produce a single, comprehensive, immutable record of the actual operation performed, from which planned-vs-actual comparison, specimen tracking, pathology handoff, complication tracking and the Treatment Summary are all derived.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                |
| **Header**                                                                                                         | Patient identifiers; episode; **Surgical Plan version referenced** (auto-linked, R); operation date; operation start time; operation end time; theatre; urgency (from plan); **pre-operative diagnosis** (auto from plan, confirmable); **post-operative diagnosis** (free text + coded, R — may differ from pre-op diagnosis, e.g. upstaging on direct visualisation); **planned procedure** (read-only, from `SCR-SO-003`) displayed **side by side** with **actual procedure performed** (editable, R) per `GEN-CMP-001` — never a single mutable field; site; laterality (checkpoint 5 of 5, reconfirmed on note opening, `SO-002`).                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            |
| **Sections (fixed order)**                                                                                         | 1 Patient/procedure context (header, above) · 2 Team · 3 Anaesthesia (cross-reference) · 4 Position & preparation · 5 Approach · 6 Incision/access · 7 Intra-operative findings · 8 Procedure steps · 9 Oncology-specific record · 10 Reconstruction · 11 Specimens · 12 Implants · 13 Blood loss & transfusion · 14 Drains & devices placed · 15 Counts · 16 Complications · 17 Wound closure · 18 Disposition · 19 Immediate post-operative plan · 20 Signature.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  |
| **Fields — Team**                                                                                                  | Primary surgeon (auto from roster, R); Assistant surgeon(s) (repeating, with role: First assistant / Second assistant / Trainee — operating / Trainee — assisting, R per assistant); Anaesthetist (auto, R); Scrub nurse; Circulating nurse; Other specialists present (e.g. reconstructive surgeon, radiologist for intra-op imaging, perfusionist) with role. **`SO-052 [PRODUCT]`**: trainee operating role is a distinct, auditable field (not inferred from "assistant"), because supervision level is a governance-relevant fact.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                             |
| **Fields — Anaesthesia (cross-reference, read-only)**                                                              | Anaesthesia type; airway management summary; major intra-operative anaesthetic events — **sourced from the Anaesthetist's own Intra-operative Anaesthetic Record (****`B.21.8`****), displayed read-only here** (`SO-006`); link to the full anaesthetic record.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    |
| **Fields — Position & preparation**                                                                                | Patient position (dropdown: Supine / Prone / Lateral — left/right / Lithotomy / Sitting / Other); Positioning aids used; Skin preparation agent `[CCA CONFIG]`; Draping method; **Prophylactic antibiotics** (auto-imported from Time Out confirmation, `SO-051`, with agent/dose/time, editable only via addendum); **VTE prophylaxis applied in theatre** (mechanical device confirmed in use); Active warming device used (Y/N + type); Pressure-area protection devices; Urinary catheter inserted (Y/N, type, time).                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                           |
| **Fields — Approach**                                                                                              | Approach actually used (Open / Laparoscopic / Robotic / Thoracoscopic / Hybrid / Other) displayed **against the planned approach** (`GEN-CMP-001`); **Conversion** (Y/N — R); where Y: **reason for conversion** (dropdown — product-defined: bleeding / adhesions / anatomical difficulty / equipment failure / oncological extent greater than anticipated / patient physiological intolerance / other, R) and **conversion timestamp**.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          |
| **Fields — Incision/access**                                                                                       | Incision type/location (coded + free text); Incision length where relevant; Access technique (for laparoscopic/robotic: port placement — repeating: port number, size, location, instrument).                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                       |
| **Fields — Intra-operative findings**                                                                              | Tumour location (confirmed vs pre-op imaging, concordant Y/N); Tumour extent as visualised; Local invasion (structures involved, multiselect + free text); Metastatic disease found intra-operatively (Y/N — repeating: site, appearance, biopsied Y/N); Adhesions (none/mild/moderate/dense, location); Nodal findings (stations visualised, appearance, palpable disease); Adjacent structures — status of each structure at risk for the procedure (preserved / involved / sacrificed, per structure, `[CCA CONFIG]` list scoped to procedure); **Unexpected findings** (free text, R if any — flagged for MDT re-discussion consideration).                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                     |
| **Fields — Procedure steps**                                                                                       | **Structured ordered key-steps list** (repeating: step number, step name from a procedure-specific step template `[CCA CONFIG]`, narrative detail, structures identified/preserved/divided per step); Extent of resection achieved (dropdown/text scoped to procedure); **Completeness of resection as assessed intra-operatively** (dropdown: Complete — macroscopically clear / Incomplete — gross residual disease / Uncertain, pending pathology) — distinct from, and not to be confused with, the pathological margin status determined later (`GEN-CMP-001`-style pairing, `SO-053 [PRODUCT]`).                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              |
| **Fields — Oncology-specific record**                                                                              | **Margins** — surgeon's intra-operative assessment per margin (site, distance where visually/palpably estimated, orientation marking applied); **Intra-operative margin assessment method** (None / Frozen section / Gross visual only / Intra-operative imaging); **Nodal procedure performed** (Sentinel node biopsy — technique, number retrieved, intra-operative result if rapid method used; and/or Regional lymphadenectomy — levels/stations dissected, estimated node count); **En bloc structures removed** (multiselect + free text); **Tumour rupture/spillage** (Y/N — R for applicable tumour types `[CCA CONFIG]`, with management if occurred — `SO-054 [PRODUCT]`: tumour spillage is a discrete, mandatory, structured field because it is independently prognostic and must never be buried in narrative); **Intra-operative frozen section requested** (Y/N — link to `SCR-SO-021`); **Frozen section result** (read-only from pathology response); **How the frozen result changed the procedure** (structured: No change / Extended resection / Changed nodal approach / Aborted planned reconstruction / Other, with narrative, R when a frozen section was performed — `SO-055 [PRODUCT]`). |
| **Fields — Reconstruction**                                                                                        | Reconstruction performed (Y/N, against the plan's reconstruction-planned flag per `GEN-CMP-001`); Type; Technique; Graft/flap type and donor site where applicable; Reconstruction surgeon (may differ from primary surgeon, attributed); Implant/device used (link to Implants table below); Viability assessment at closure (e.g. flap perfusion check) where applicable.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                         |
| **Fields — Specimens (repeating group — table)**                                                                   | **Specimen number** (auto-sequenced, R); **Specimen label** (as physically labelled, R); Anatomical site; Laterality; **Orientation** (structured description + optional diagram/photo attachment, consumed by `SO-031`'s pathology handling instructions); **Margin designation applied** (which margins are marked, with which marking method — suture/ink/clip `[CCA CONFIG]`); Fresh or fixed; **Special test requested at time of excision** (e.g. hormone receptor, molecular, microbiology, frozen section — multiselect); **Destination** (Histopathology / Microbiology / Research — with consent status where research `[CCA CONFIG]` / Cytogenetics); Sent to pathology time; **Pathology accession number** `[DERIVED — populated on receipt]` (`SO-004` traceability link); Accession confirmation status `[DERIVED]` (Sent / Received — with discrepancy flag if a specimen sent is not accessioned within a configured interval, `SO-056 [PRODUCT]`).                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                |
| **Fields — Implants (repeating group — table, written to the cross-cutting device register per** **`SO-011`****)** | Item; Category (Mesh / Prosthesis / Expander / Fiducial / Port / Other); Manufacturer; Model; **Serial/lot number** (R, scanned where configured); Site of implantation; Implanting surgeon.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        |
| **Fields — Blood loss & transfusion**                                                                              | **Estimated blood loss** (numeric, mL, R — with method noted: visual estimation / suction + swab weight / other `[CCA CONFIG]`); Fluids administered (crystalloid/colloid volumes — cross-reference to anaesthetic record); **Blood products transfused** (repeating: component, units, batch/lot — cross-reference to Blood Bank's own transfusion record per `BLD-010`, displayed read-only here with a link, `SO-006`); Urine output during the case where measured.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                             |
| **Fields — Drains & devices placed**                                                                               | Repeating: type; number; location; laterality; exit site; suction or gravity; **plan** (e.g. "remove when output < x mL/24h" `[CCA CONFIG]` — feeds `SCR-SO-013`'s removal-criteria field); each drain assigned its own device identifier (`SO-008`) that the post-operative drain record (`SCR-SO-013`) will track thereafter.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                     |
| **Fields — Counts**                                                                                                | **Read-only import from the Theatre Safety Gate Sign-Out count record** (`SO-051`); count type (swab/needle/instrument); correct/incorrect; where incorrect, the recorded discrepancy-resolution action (`SO-049`) displayed here for completeness — not re-entered.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                |
| **Fields — Complications (intra-operative)**                                                                       | Repeating: complication (coded + free text); severity (per the configured intra-operative complication scale `[CCA CONFIG]`, distinct from the post-operative grading in `SCR-SO-015`); management; outcome. Where any complication is recorded, the **"Affects adjuvant timing" flag** (`SO-009`) is presented for the surgeon's immediate assessment (may be revised later at `SCR-SO-015`).                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      |
| **Fields — Wound closure**                                                                                         | Closure layers and technique per layer; Suture/staple material per layer `[CCA CONFIG]`; Wound classification `[CCA CONFIG]` where used (e.g. clean/clean-contaminated/contaminated/dirty — a recognised infection-risk stratification, content and thresholds `[CCA CONFIG]`); Dressing applied (type).                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            |
| **Fields — Disposition**                                                                                           | Immediate post-operative destination (PACU / Ward / HDU / ICU — actual, compared against the plan's anticipated level of care per `GEN-CMP-001`); Ventilated on transfer (Y/N); Accompanying staff.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                 |
| **Fields — Immediate post-operative plan**                                                                         | Analgesia plan; Antibiotic continuation plan; VTE prophylaxis continuation plan; Diet/fluid plan; Mobilisation plan; Drain care instructions (per drain); Wound care instructions; Investigations ordered for the post-operative period (launches `SCR-INV-001`); Activity/positioning restrictions; Pathology follow-up plan (who reviews the report, target date); Next clinical review (surgeon ward round timing).                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              |
| **Fields — Signature**                                                                                             | Primary surgeon signature (R, re-authenticated); Assistant surgeon co-signature where the institution requires it for trainee-operated cases `[CCA CONFIG — CLINICAL SIGN-OFF]`; date/time of signature (distinct from operation end time).                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                         |
| **Tables**                                                                                                         | Team roster; procedure steps (structured); specimens; implants; blood products; drains placed; counts (read-only); complications.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                   |
| **Dropdowns**                                                                                                      | Position, approach, conversion reason, resection-completeness, tumour-spillage-management, wound classification, complication severity scale — product-defined backbones + `[CCA CONFIG]` extensions; specimen destination, special test (`[CCA CONFIG]` catalogue).                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                |
| **Calculated**                                                                                                     | **Operative duration** `[DERIVED]` (`CALC-194` = end time − start time); **Estimated blood loss** aggregation where multiple sub-estimates are entered `[DERIVED]` (`CALC-193`); specimen-accession discrepancy flag (`SO-056`); planned-vs-actual concordance flags for procedure, approach, and level of care (`GEN-CMP-001`, `[DERIVED]`).                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                       |
| **Actions**                                                                                                        | Add procedure step · Add specimen row · Add implant row · Add drain row · Add complication · Request frozen section (→ `SCR-SO-021`) · Import Theatre Safety Gate data · Import anaesthetic record reference · Save draft · **Sign**.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                               |
| **Chips**                                                                                                          | Draft/Signed; conversion occurred (persistent amber); tumour spillage (persistent red where positive); complication present; specimen accession status per specimen; planned-vs-actual concordance (Concordant / Deviated — with the deviated fields named).                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        |
| **Alerts**                                                                                                         | **Hard stop on sign:** actual procedure not recorded; site/laterality not reconfirmed at note opening; incision time precedes Time Out completion (`SO-050`); any specimen row missing a label or destination; count status not "resolved" (`SO-049`); no primary surgeon signature. **Warning:** operative duration exceeds the plan's estimate by a configured margin `[CCA CONFIG]`; blood loss exceeds a configured threshold without a documented transfusion decision; frozen section requested but no result recorded at signature (offers to hold as draft pending result — `SO-057 [PRODUCT]`: the note may remain in a "pending frozen section result" sub-state rather than forcing premature signature or an unsigned indefinite draft).                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                |
| **Conditional logic**                                                                                              | Reconstruction section renders only when reconstruction performed; conversion-reason field appears only when approach ≠ planned approach; frozen-section result field appears only when requested; nodal fields scoped to disease site `[CCA CONFIG]`.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              |
| **Read-only**                                                                                                      | Planned procedure, planned approach, planned level of care (all from `SCR-SO-003`, displayed for comparison only); Theatre Safety Gate team/timing/count data; Blood Bank transfusion record reference; Anaesthetic record reference.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                               |
| **Sign/approve**                                                                                                   | Primary surgeon signature is authoritative and exclusive (`SO-001`). Once signed, the note is **immutable**.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        |
| **Amendment/version**                                                                                              | Corrections occur only by **addendum** (appended, separately timestamped and signed) or formal **amendment** (new version, reason required, original retained and viewable) — never by editing signed content (`GEN-SIG-001`).                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      |
| **Comparison view**                                                                                                | Planned procedure/approach/level-of-care vs actual, side by side, permanently available on the note and on the Treatment Summary (`GEN-CMP-001`).                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                   |
| **Post-signature**                                                                                                 | Note immutable; specimens released to pathology tracking; implants written to device register; drains/devices become tracked objects in `SCR-SO-013`/`SCR-SO-014`; complications (if any) feed the toxicity/complication longitudinal view; disposition drives ward/HDU/ICU admission workflow; "Affects adjuvant timing" flag (if set) visible to `SCR-SO-018`.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    |
| **Downstream queues**                                                                                              | Pathology accession worklist (per specimen); Post-operative nursing (`SCR-SO-010` pre-population); Ward admission; Blood Bank reconciliation; Device register; Treatment Summary.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                   |
| **Blocked state**                                                                                                  | Cannot open before Time Out complete (`SO-050`); cannot sign with unresolved counts.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                |
| **Print/export**                                                                                                   | Full Operative Note (all sections, page-numbered); abbreviated Operative Summary for immediate ward handover; specimen labels/requisitions (if not already generated at labelling).                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                 |

## C.18.10 · `SCR-SO-010` — Immediate Post-operative Note

| Dimension Specification  |                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            |
| ------------------------ | ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| **Role(s)**              | Surgeon or covering clinician (author, sign); PACU/recovery nurse (contributes recovery data, cross-referenced not re-typed).                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              |

screens.requirement_markdown:
## C.18.16 · `SCR-SO-018` — Adjuvant Handoff

*A proper accountable workflow with an acknowledging receiver, not a task checkbox — by explicit instruction.*

| Dimension Specification              |                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                           |
| ------------------------------------ | ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| **Role(s)**                          | Surgical Oncologist (initiate); MO/RO/MDT Coordinator (receive, acknowledge); Navigator (monitor).                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        |
| **Navigation**                       | Auto-created when `SCR-SO-016` is signed with a referral flag set, or manually from the pathway board "Adjuvant Handoff Pending" tab.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                     |
| **Purpose**                          | Ensure that operated patients whose pathology is available are demonstrably and accountably transferred to the specialty that will decide and deliver adjuvant therapy — closing the loop that was previously the weakest point in the pathway.                                                                                                                                                                                           |
| **Header**                           | Full header; handoff strip: initiated date, target date `[DERIVED]`, days elapsed `[DERIVED]`, status.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    |
| **Sections**                         | 1 Surgical summary · 2 Recovery status · 3 Final pathology summary · 4 Readiness assessment · 5 Routing & ownership · 6 Acknowledgement.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  |
| **Fields — Surgical summary**        | Surgery performed; surgical date; approach; complications summary (read-only from `SCR-SO-015`, with the "affects adjuvant timing" flag surfaced prominently).                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            |
| **Fields — Recovery status**         | Current status (Discharged — recovered / Discharged — with ongoing issues / Still inpatient / Readmitted); wound status; drains removed (Y/N, or "not applicable"); infection present (Y/N); post-op performance status (assessed, dated).                                                                                                                                                                                                |
| **Fields — Final pathology summary** | Pathological stage (read-only from `SCR-SO-017`); margins; nodes; biomarkers — auto-assembled, not re-typed.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              |
| **Fields — Readiness assessment**    | **Readiness for adjuvant discussion** (dropdown, R: Ready now / Ready pending recovery — target date / Not ready — reason, e.g. unresolved complication); Responsible specialty for the adjuvant decision (dropdown: Medical Oncology / Radiation Oncology / Both / MDT to decide, R); **MDT required?** (Y/N — auto-suggested from `SO-061`'s flag and pathway rules `[CCA CONFIG]`, confirmable).                                       |
| **Fields — Routing & ownership**     | **Target date** `[DERIVED]` (from a configured target interval `[CCA CONFIG]` off the surgery date or the pathology-report date, whichever the institution specifies) with countdown (`CALC-202`); **Action owner** (named clinician/service, R); Due date (editable with reason); Handoff method (Direct referral / MDT submission / Both).                                                                                              |
| **Fields — Acknowledgement**         | **Acknowledged by receiver** (name, role, date/time, R for the handoff to close — `SO-062 [PRODUCT]`: a handoff is not complete when sent; it is complete when a named receiver acknowledges it, mirroring the results-inbox acknowledgement discipline of `MO-INV-010`); Receiver's initial plan (brief structured response: Will proceed to consultation — date booked / Will await further information — specify / Declines — reason). |
| **Tables**                           | Handoff history (for cases with more than one handoff event, e.g. handed to MO then re-routed to MDT).                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    |
| **Calculated**                       | Days elapsed since surgery/pathology `[DERIVED]`; target-date countdown (`CALC-202`); overdue flag `[DERIVED]` against `[CCA CONFIG]` target.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                             |
| **Actions**                          | Initiate handoff · Route to specialty · Submit to MDT · Acknowledge (receiver) · Escalate (unacknowledged beyond target) · Close handoff.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                 |
| **Chips**                            | Handoff status (Pending / Acknowledged / In progress / Closed); overdue (red beyond target).                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              |
| **Alerts**                           | Handoff unacknowledged beyond the configured target interval → escalation banner to Navigator and to the surgeon who initiated it (`SO-063 [PRODUCT]`).                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                   |
| **Downstream**                       | Receiver's consultation worklist entry created; MDT submission draft created where flagged; pathway board "Adjuvant Handoff Pending" tab cleared on acknowledgement; Treatment Summary.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                   |
| **Print/export**                     | Adjuvant Handoff record (for the receiving specialty's file).                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                             |

## C.18.18 · `SCR-SO-020` — Surgical Discharge

*A mature, surgery-specific discharge summary — deliberately not the generic inpatient discharge document.*

| Dimension Specification                          |                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    |
| ------------------------------------------------ | -------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| **Role(s)**                                      | Surgical Oncologist / registrar (author, sign); Inpatient Nurse (education, contributes read-only).                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                |
| **Navigation**                                   | Post-op Inpatients worklist → "Discharge"; gated by a discharge-readiness assessment.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              |
| **Purpose**                                      | A structured, assembled, signed document safely transferring surgical care to the patient/community/next specialty.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                |
| **Sections**                                     | 1 Diagnosis & operation · 2 Hospital course · 3 Complications · 4 Wounds/drains/stoma at discharge · 5 Medications · 6 Diet & activity · 7 Wound/drain/stoma care instructions · 8 Pathology status · 9 Red flags & emergency contact · 10 Follow-up & adjuvant plan · 11 Patient education & comprehension · 12 Condition at discharge · 13 Sign. |
| **Fields — Diagnosis & operation**               | Diagnosis (auto); Operation performed (auto, actual — from `SCR-SO-009`); Operation date; Surgeon.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                 |
| **Fields — Hospital course**                     | Auto-assembled narrative from daily progress notes (`MO-CON-060`/`SO-059` pattern — assembled, not re-typed), editable summary layer on top.                                                                                                                                                                                                       |
| **Fields — Complications**                       | Auto-listed from `SCR-SO-015` with grade and resolution status; "None" is an affirmative, attributed statement, not an empty section (`GEN-LNG-001` NKDA-pattern applied to complications).                                                                                                                                                        |
| **Fields — Wounds/drains/stoma at discharge**    | Read-only current status from `SCR-SO-012`/`013`/`014`: wound(s) status and planned suture/staple removal date and location (community/clinic); drains remaining in situ (Y/N, with take-home management plan) or "all removed"; stoma status and independence level, with supply prescription reference.                                          |
| **Fields — Medications**                         | Discharge medication list (from reconciled `GEN-LNG-002`), with **anticoagulation restart plan** re-stated explicitly (cross-referenced from `SCR-SO-004`'s plan, confirmed current); analgesia; antibiotics (course completion date); other new/changed medications.                                                                              |
| **Fields — Diet & activity**                     | Diet at discharge; mobility status; **activity restrictions** — lifting limit and duration, driving restriction and duration, return-to-work guidance (with an occupation-specific note where relevant) — each a discrete structured field, not buried in narrative (`SO-064 [PRODUCT]`).                                                          |
| **Fields — Wound/drain/stoma care instructions** | Structured, versioned instruction set `[CCA CONFIG — CLINICAL SIGN-OFF]` for content; product structure requires: what to look for, what is normal, what is not, who to contact.                                                                                                                                                                   |
| **Fields — Pathology status**                    | Result available and reviewed with patient (Y/N); result pending (Y/N — with the plan for communicating it once available, R if pending — `SO-065 [PRODUCT]`: a discharge occurring before final pathology is available must state, in structured form, who will communicate the result and by when).                                              |
| **Fields — Red flags & emergency contact**       | **Structured, mandatory, versioned red-flag symptom list and thresholds** `[CCA CONFIG — CLINICAL SIGN-OFF]` (mirrors `MAR-025`'s discipline exactly — never narrative advice); 24-hour surgical contact number; nearest-emergency-department instruction.                                                                                         |
| **Fields — Follow-up & adjuvant plan**           | Follow-up appointment (date, with whom); Adjuvant/MDT plan status (read-only roll-up from `SCR-SO-018`); Investigations to be done before follow-up (list with booking status).                                                                                                                                                                    |
| **Fields — Patient education & comprehension**   | Education delivered (checklist with material versions: wound care, drain/stoma care, medication, red flags, activity restrictions, follow-up); Comprehension confirmed (method: teach-back / verbal / written); Carer/family involved in education.                                                                                                |
| **Fields — Condition at discharge**              | Dropdown (product-defined): Recovered as expected / Recovering with ongoing minor issues / Discharged with unresolved complication (link to `SCR-SO-015`) / Discharged against medical advice (with capacity/counselling documentation).                                                                                                           |
| **Tables**                                       | Discharge medication list; red-flag list; follow-up appointment list.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              |
| **Calculated**                                   | Length of stay `[DERIVED]`; days to first follow-up `[DERIVED]`.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                   |
| **Actions**                                      | Assemble from record · Edit summary layer · Print patient copy · Print GP/referrer copy · Sign.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    |
| **Chips**                                        | Discharge readiness (`CALC-198`); pathology pending flag; complication-at-discharge flag.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          |
| **Alerts**                                       | **Hard stop on sign:** no red-flag instruction set issued; no follow-up appointment or explicit plan recorded; complication register not reconciled (open complication with no documented plan). **Warning:** pathology pending without a stated communication plan; drain/stoma present without a documented take-home plan.                      |

| **Amendment/version**                            | Addendum only once signed.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                         |
