screens.requirement_markdown:
## C.18.19 · `SCR-SO-021` — Intraoperative Frozen Section Consultation

| Dimension Specification             |                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                         |
| ----------------------------------- | ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| **Role(s)**                         | Surgeon (request); Pathologist (receive, process, respond) — see also `C.19` for the pathology-side worklist and processing screens.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    |
| **Navigation**                      | From `SCR-SO-009` "Request frozen section"; Pathology's intra-operative worklist.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                       |
| **Purpose**                         | Time-critical, bidirectional, auditable exchange between operating room and pathology, distinct from the routine specimen-to-accession pathway because it gates an in-progress operation.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                               |
| **Fields — Request**                | Specimen description; Anatomical site/laterality; **Specific question** (R — e.g. "margin clearance", "nodal involvement" — mirrors `MDT-020`'s no-vague-question discipline); Requesting surgeon; Request time; Urgency (always time-critical — no priority selector needed); Clinical context auto-assembled (diagnosis, procedure in progress).                                                                                                                      |
| **Fields — Response (Pathologist)** | Received time `[DERIVED]` transit duration; Processing start time; **Result** (structured per the question type, e.g. margin: clear/involved/close with distance where determinable on frozen tissue; nodal: positive/negative/count); Limitations of frozen assessment stated (narrative, R — freezing artefact, sampling limitation); Result time; Reported by (named pathologist); **Deferred to permanent section** (Y/N, where frozen assessment is inconclusive). |
| **Calculated**                      | Turnaround time `[DERIVED]` (request to result) — tracked for departmental performance reporting.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                       |
| **Actions**                         | Send request · Acknowledge receipt (pathology) · Enter result · Notify requesting surgeon (push notification to the live Operative Note screen, `SO-055`) · Flag as deferred to permanent.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              |
| **Alerts**                          | No acknowledgement within a configured interval `[CCA CONFIG]` → escalation to pathology lead, visible to the waiting operating room.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                   |
| **Downstream**                      | Result feeds `SCR-SO-009`'s frozen-section fields directly (`SO-055`, not re-typed); permanent-section result later reconciles against the frozen impression, with any discordance flagged for the surgeon's and pathologist's joint review (`SO-066 [PRODUCT]`) — a frozen/permanent discordance must be visible, not silently superseded.                                                                                                                             |
| **Print/export**                    | Frozen Section Consultation record (becomes part of the permanent pathology file).                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      |
